resources.name: Wood
resources.description: Forests and scrub. Deadfall and branches can be gathered by hand.

resources.name: Stone
resources.description: River cobbles, scree, outcrops. Rounded hard cobbles serve as hammerstones.

resources.name: Flint
resources.description: Dark glassy nodules in chalk and limestone, or river gravels. Breaks with a shell-shaped scar.

resources.name: Plant fiber
resources.description: Stalks of flax, nettle, hemp and inner tree bark. Long strands peel away when the stalk is rotted and beaten.
resources.how: Break grass and ferns by hand; about a third yield usable fibre.

resources.name: Wild game
resources.description: Deer, boar and similar animals on grassland and forest edge.
resources.requirement: Wild game: a deer-sized wild animal (pig, cow, sheep, goat, rabbit...) within 16 blocks

resources.name: Clay
resources.description: River banks and lake beds. Sticky and plastic when wet, cracks as it dries.

resources.name: Fireclay
resources.description: Pale clay found under coal seams and in weathered granite (kaolin). Survives heat that slumps ordinary clay.

resources.name: Sand
resources.description: River bars, beaches, dunes. Pale quartz-rich sand is the useful kind.

resources.name: Water
resources.description: Rivers, springs, wells, rain.
resources.requirement: Water: stand within 4 blocks of a water source, or carry a water bucket or bottle

resources.name: Wild grain
resources.description: Stands of wild wheat, barley, rice or millet in seasonal grassland.

resources.name: Wild herd animals
resources.description: Aurochs, wild sheep and goats that live in herds and follow a leader.
resources.requirement: Wild herd animals: two adult cows, sheep or goats within 16 blocks

resources.name: Limestone
resources.description: Pale layered rock, often full of shells. Fizzes when sour liquid is dropped on it.

resources.name: Salt
resources.description: Salt pans, brine springs, rock-salt outcrops, evaporated seawater.

resources.name: Native copper
resources.description: Rare reddish metallic nuggets near green-stained rock. Dents instead of shattering when struck.

resources.name: Malachite
resources.description: Bright green banded stone in weathered outcrops. A copper carbonate ore.

resources.name: Cassiterite
resources.description: Heavy black pebbles in stream gravels below granite hills. Tin oxide.

resources.name: Iron ore
resources.description: Red hematite earth, rusty bog-ore nodules in marshes, black magnetite sands.

resources.name: Native gold
resources.description: Yellow flakes and nuggets in stream gravels. Never tarnishes.

resources.name: Galena
resources.description: Heavy silver-grey cubic crystals in veins. Lead sulfide, usually carrying a little silver.

resources.name: Zinc ore
resources.description: Calamine and sphalerite in veins near lead ore. Dull, easily overlooked.

resources.name: Sulfur
resources.description: Yellow crusts around volcanic vents and hot springs. Burns with a blue flame and choking smell.

resources.name: Niter
resources.description: White crust on cave walls, cellar earth and dry manured soil. Tastes cool and makes embers flare.

resources.name: Lodestone
resources.description: Black magnetite struck by lightning. Picks up iron filings.

resources.name: Amber
resources.description: Fossil tree resin washed up on shores. Attracts chaff when rubbed.

resources.name: Cinnabar
resources.description: Vermilion-red heavy mineral in veins near old volcanoes. Mercury sulfide.

resources.name: Coal
resources.description: Black combustible rock in seams between shale and sandstone.

resources.name: Graphite
resources.description: Soft grey-black greasy mineral that marks surfaces. Pure carbon.

resources.name: Manganese ore
resources.description: Black sooty pyrolusite in weathered deposits.

resources.name: Quartz
resources.description: Clear to milky hexagonal crystals in veins and pegmatites. Nearly pure silica.

resources.name: Borax
resources.description: White crusts on dry lake beds in deserts.

resources.name: Fluorite
resources.description: Glassy cubic crystals, often purple or green, in veins. Calcium fluoride. Makes smelting slags runny.

resources.name: Platinum
resources.description: Grey unmeltable grains found with placer gold. Long discarded as a nuisance.

resources.name: Bitumen
resources.description: Black tarry seeps and pitch lakes where oil reaches the surface.

resources.name: Rubber latex
resources.description: Milky sap of certain tropical trees. Dries to a stretchy film.
resources.how: Break jungle logs: tropical trees bleed latex.

resources.name: Crude oil
resources.description: Underground liquid trapped beneath rock domes, betrayed by seeps.

resources.name: Bauxite
resources.description: Reddish, earthy, pea-textured rock in tropical soils. Aluminium hydroxides.

resources.name: Chromite
resources.description: Heavy black grains and layers in dark igneous rock.

resources.name: Nickel ore
resources.description: Sulfide ores beside dark igneous rock, or green-stained tropical laterite.

resources.name: Wolframite
resources.description: Very heavy dark bladed crystals in quartz veins beside tin ore.

resources.name: Phosphate rock
resources.description: Beds of fossil bone and shell, or guano. Calcium phosphate.

resources.name: Arsenic ore
resources.description: Silvery arsenopyrite in metal veins. Gives a garlic smell when struck or roasted.

resources.name: Rare-earth ore
resources.description: Monazite sands and bastnäsite in unusual carbonate rocks.

resources.name: Air
resources.description: The atmosphere. Roughly four parts nitrogen to one part oxygen, plus about 1% argon.

resources.name: Wildfire
resources.description: Fires started by lightning or dry heat. Seen to spread through dry fuel and die without it.
resources.requirement: Fire or lava burning within 8 blocks of you

resources.name: Night sky
resources.description: The fixed stars, wandering planets and the phases of the moon, repeating on schedule.
resources.requirement: An open, clear night sky above you

resources.name: Seasonal cycle
resources.description: The yearly return of warmth, rain, floods and plant growth.
resources.requirement: Having lived through a full cycle of days and nights

resources.name: Flowing river
resources.description: A stream with steady flow and a drop in height. A site requirement for water power.
resources.requirement: Flowing water (a stream with current) within 6 blocks

resources.name: Sunlight
resources.description: Daylight. Casts sharp shadows, bends in water, splits into colours in a rainbow.

resources.name: Medicinal plants
resources.description: Willow, poppy, fever-bark trees and many herbs. Known by the effects of chewing or steeping them.

resources.name: Wild horses
resources.description: Herds on open grassland. Fast, strong and wary.
resources.requirement: Wild horses: an untamed horse, donkey or camel within 16 blocks

resources.name: Natural gas
resources.description: Flammable gas trapped above oil or alone under rock domes. Mostly methane.

resources.name: Titanium ore
resources.description: Heavy black and red-brown grains in certain beach sands (ilmenite, rutile).

resources.name: Lithium ore
resources.description: Pale spodumene crystals in coarse granite veins, and brines under desert salt flats.

resources.name: Wind
resources.description: Steady moving air, strongest on coasts, plains and ridges. A site requirement for wind power.
resources.requirement: An exposed, high site with open sky (at least 10 blocks above sea level)

resources.name: Open water
resources.description: Sea, lake or navigable river. Things float or sink in it, and it can be crossed.
resources.requirement: A body of open water (lake, sea or wide river) within 8 blocks

functions.name: Conchoidal fracture
functions.mechanism: Glassy, fine-grained rock has no grain or cleavage, so a sharp blow sends a cone-shaped crack through it and peels off a flake with a razor edge. Strike angle and force set the flake's size and shape.
functions.notes: Unlocks all knapped tools. Every later cutting edge descends from this.

functions.name: Cordage twisting
functions.mechanism: Twist two fibre bundles one way, then wrap them round each other the opposite way. The opposed twists lock by friction, so a pull is shared across many short fibres.

functions.name: Control of fire
functions.mechanism: Burning needs fuel, heat and air together, and stops when any one is removed. Fine dry tinder lights at lower heat than logs, so a fire is built from small to large and kept alive by feeding and banking.
functions.notes: Unlocks every heat-driven process. Cooking raises the food value of meat and grain.

functions.name: Knapping
functions.mechanism: Strike the core's edge at under 90° with a hammerstone. Each scar leaves a ridge that steers the next flake, so the core is shaped into an axe and the waste flakes become blades.

functions.name: Spear making
functions.mechanism: Scrape a straight sapling to a point. The shaft gives reach and puts the whole body's thrust onto one small area.

functions.name: Fire drill making
functions.mechanism: A hardwood spindle spun by a bow in a softwood notch grinds off dust and heats it by friction past about 400 °C until it glows as an ember, which is blown into tinder.

functions.name: Hafting
functions.mechanism: Binding the head into a split handle lengthens the swing arc. The head arrives far faster than a hand-held stone, and energy rises with the square of speed.

functions.name: Hunting
functions.mechanism: Approach downwind and strike the chest cavity. Cooperative driving toward a trap or cliff multiplies the yield of a small band.
functions.worldHint: Kill a wild animal with a hunting weapon (spear, musket or rifle) to get a carcass.

functions.name: Hearth building
functions.mechanism: A ring of stones shields the fire from wind, stops it spreading, and soaks up heat that it radiates back long after the flames die down.
functions.notes: Station. The first means of production for anything heated.

functions.name: Timber felling
functions.mechanism: Cut a notch on the fall side and a back cut above it so the trunk hinges over. Split logs along the grain with wedges, where wood is weakest.

functions.name: Butchery
functions.mechanism: A fresh flint edge parts skin from muscle along the connective tissue. Tendons are dried into sinew, fat is rendered, long bones are kept for tools.
functions.notes: Meat feeds the band. The by-products are the first engineered materials.

functions.name: Pyrolysis
functions.mechanism: Wood heated with too little air cannot burn. Its water and tarry vapours are driven off and nearly pure carbon is left, which burns hotter and cleaner than wood because no heat is spent boiling off the volatiles.
functions.notes: Unlocks charcoal, tar, and later coke and coal-tar chemistry.

functions.name: Ash burning
functions.mechanism: The mineral part of wood, mostly potassium and calcium carbonates, cannot burn and is left as ash. Hardwoods give the most.

functions.name: Tanning
functions.mechanism: Scrape off flesh and hair, then soak in bark liquor. Tannins bind the skin's collagen fibres so they no longer rot when wet or go stiff when dry.

functions.name: Bone working
functions.mechanism: Groove and snap a splinter of long bone, grind it to a point on sandstone, and bore an eye with a flint tip. Bone is tough where flint is brittle.

functions.name: Charcoal burning
functions.mechanism: Stack wood tightly, seal it under turf and clay, light it through a central flue and throttle the vents for days. A little wood burns to heat the rest, which chars. Tar drains out at the base.
functions.notes: Charcoal is the only fuel hot and clean enough for metal until coke.

functions.name: Plant domestication
functions.mechanism: A seed grows into the same kind of plant as its parent. Saving seed from the best plants shifts the crop over generations toward bigger grains that stay on the stalk. Sowing must be timed to the rains, and soil tires unless rested or manured.
functions.notes: Unlocks farming. A food surplus frees labour for specialists.

functions.name: Hoe making
functions.mechanism: A stone blade lashed across a handle chops and turns soil, burying weeds and opening a loose seedbed that roots and water can penetrate.

functions.name: Quern making
functions.mechanism: Peck a rough sandstone slab into a dished bed with a matching rubbing stone. The gritty surface tears grain open instead of merely crushing it.

functions.name: Spindle making
functions.mechanism: A stick weighted with a pierced stone disc acts as a flywheel. Its stored spin keeps twisting the fibre while both hands draw out the strand.

functions.name: Tablet making
functions.mechanism: A palm-sized slab of fine wet clay takes crisp impressions from a cut reed or stick, and dries hard enough to store. Firing makes it permanent.

functions.name: Field clearing
functions.mechanism: Clear, till and sow selected seed at the right season in ground near water. Weeding removes the competition for light and moisture.
functions.notes: Infrastructure.

functions.name: Spinning
functions.mechanism: Rot the stalks in water so bacteria dissolve the gum binding the fibres, beat and comb them, then draw out and twist. Twist presses the fibres together so friction carries the load.

functions.name: Ceramic transformation
functions.mechanism: Above about 600 °C clay minerals lose their chemically bound water and the particles fuse at their contacts. The change cannot be reversed, so fired clay no longer softens in water. Ware must be dried first or trapped steam bursts it, and gritty temper stops cracks running.
functions.notes: Unlocks pottery, brick, kilns, crucibles and furnace linings.

functions.name: Workbench building
functions.mechanism: A heavy flat top at waist height with pegs to hold work. It frees both hands and gives a fixed reference surface for assembly.
functions.notes: Station. General-purpose means of production.

functions.name: Loom building
functions.mechanism: An upright frame holds the lengthwise threads taut under stone weights. A bar lifts every other thread at once so the cross thread passes in one throw.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Lever and simple machines
functions.mechanism: Force can be traded for distance. On a lever, effort times its arm equals load times its arm. The wedge, ramp, screw, pulley and wheel-and-axle obey the same rule: what is gained in force is lost in travel.
functions.notes: Unlocks wheels, presses, cranes, balances and gearing.

functions.name: Meat salting
functions.mechanism: Salt draws water out of the flesh and out of whatever would rot it. Below a certain moisture nothing can grow, so the meat keeps for months.
functions.notes: Provisions for marches, sieges and voyages.

functions.name: Pit firing
functions.mechanism: Knead out air bubbles, coil and smooth the walls, dry fully, then bury the pots in fuel and fire to dull red heat. Sand temper lets steam escape and takes up shrinkage.

functions.name: Weaving
functions.mechanism: Interlacing threads at right angles locks each in place by the friction of its neighbours, turning a one-dimensional thread into a strong flexible sheet.

functions.name: Wheelwrighting
functions.mechanism: A disc turning on a greased axle swaps sliding friction over the ground for a little sliding at the small axle. Planks are pegged across the grain so the disc does not split.

functions.name: Draft and forced air
functions.mechanism: A fire's temperature is limited by how fast air reaches the fuel and how much heat escapes. Hot gas rises, so a chimney pulls fresh air in below. Walls keep the heat in. Blowing air into charcoal raises it from red to white heat.
functions.notes: Unlocks kilns, bellows and furnaces. Each step up in temperature unlocks a new class of material.

functions.name: Glue boiling
functions.mechanism: Long simmering breaks skin and bone collagen into gelatin, which dissolves hot, gels on cooling and dries to a hard film that grips wood fibres.

functions.name: Sickle making
functions.mechanism: Small flint blades set in a grooved curved handle and glued with tar make a long serrated edge. The curve gathers stalks so one pull cuts a handful.

functions.name: Herbal medicine
functions.mechanism: Certain plants reliably change the body: willow bark eases pain and fever, poppy sap dulls pain and brings sleep, others purge or poison. The effect depends on dose and on how the plant is prepared.
functions.notes: Unlocks remedies. The first step toward pharmacology.

functions.name: Buoyancy
functions.mechanism: A body in water is pushed up by a force equal to the weight of water it pushes aside. It floats if it weighs less than its own volume of water, so a hollow shape of heavy material floats, and its load is the weight of water displaced minus its own.
functions.notes: Unlocks boats, ship design and, later, balloons.

functions.name: Kiln building
functions.mechanism: A firebox below a perforated floor, ware stacked above, and a dome with a vent. The flame is drawn up through the load, giving an even 900–1000 °C that an open fire cannot reach.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Harvesting
functions.mechanism: Cut when the ears are ripe but before they shatter, dry the sheaves, beat out the grain and winnow in the wind, which carries off the light chaff. Dry grain keeps for years.
functions.worldHint: Break fully grown crops inside a formed Grain field while holding a Sickle.

functions.name: Dugout making
functions.mechanism: Char the inside of a log with controlled fire and scrape out the charcoal, leaving thin walls that are spread wider with hot water.
functions.notes: River and coastal travel, fishing.

functions.name: Brick firing
functions.mechanism: Press tempered clay in a wooden mould, dry slowly in shade to avoid warping, then fire. Uniform blocks stack with staggered joints so loads spread through the wall.

functions.name: Mortar and pestle making
functions.mechanism: A thick bowl and club fired hard and left unglazed. Pressing and shearing between two hard rough surfaces breaks grains far finer than pounding on a flat stone.
functions.notes: Means of production for grinding and intimate mixing.

functions.name: Crucible making
functions.mechanism: Fireclay is rich in alumina and poor in the fluxes that make ordinary clay slump, so it stays rigid at metal-melting heat. Thick walls and coarse temper resist thermal shock.

functions.name: Flour milling
functions.mechanism: Rubbing grain between stones breaks the starchy core into powder and strips the bran, exposing the starch so it can cook and digest fully.

functions.name: Animal domestication
functions.mechanism: Herd animals follow a leader and tolerate crowding, so humans can take the leader's place. Controlling which animals breed selects for tameness over generations, and stored fodder carries the herd through winter.
functions.notes: Unlocks traction, dung, hides and wool without hunting.

functions.name: Counting and tally
functions.mechanism: One mark or token stands for one object, so a quantity can be stored, compared and handed over without the objects being present. Grouping marks in fives and tens leads to place value.
functions.notes: Unlocks accounting, stock keeping and measurement.

functions.name: Fermentation
functions.mechanism: Sweet mashes left warm froth and turn alcoholic. Something invisible carried in the dregs eats the sugar and gives off alcohol and gas, and it stops when the drink is strong enough to poison it. Left open to air, the drink sours to vinegar.
functions.notes: Unlocks beer, vinegar and raised bread. Feedstock for distilled spirit.

functions.name: Baking
functions.mechanism: Wet flour forms a stretchy dough. Heat sets the starch and drives off water, giving a dry, portable food that keeps for days.
functions.notes: Staple food.

functions.name: Herd penning
functions.mechanism: Capture young animals, fence them, feed them by hand and breed the calmest. A fence only has to be stronger than the animal's wish to leave.
functions.notes: Infrastructure.

functions.name: Writing
functions.mechanism: A fixed set of signs can stand for words or sounds. Anyone trained in the convention can recover the speech, so information outlives the speaker and travels without him.
functions.notes: Theories persist across generations and can be taught or traded. Prerequisite for higher theory.

functions.name: Calendar and astronomy
functions.mechanism: The sun's rising point and the first dawn appearance of certain stars return every 365¼ days, in step with the seasons. Twelve lunar months fall about 11 days short, so a lunar calendar needs an extra month now and then.
functions.notes: Sowing and flood timing become predictable. Later: navigation and mechanics.

functions.name: Fermenting
functions.mechanism: Sprout the grain so it turns its starch to sugar, dry and crush it, steep in warm water, then leave the sweet liquid to ferment. Boiling first kills spoilage.

functions.name: Remedy preparation
functions.mechanism: Dry and grind the plant, then steep or simmer it. Hot water dissolves the active substances out of the tissue and straining removes the fibre.

functions.name: Ox training
functions.mechanism: Castrated males are docile and strong. A wooden yoke across the shoulders lets them push with their full weight against a load.
functions.notes: First power source beyond human muscle.

functions.name: Dung collecting
functions.mechanism: Penned animals concentrate their droppings. Dung returns to the soil the nutrients that grazing removed, and rotting dung is rich in nitrogen compounds.

functions.name: Arithmetic
functions.mechanism: Positional notation lets the same few digits express any number. Fixed procedures for adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing, and fractions for parts, give exact answers without handling the things counted.
functions.notes: Unlocks measurement, proportion and engineering calculation.

functions.name: Geometry
functions.mechanism: A rope knotted 3-4-5 makes a square corner. Areas and volumes follow from lengths, similar triangles give heights and distances that cannot be paced, and results can be proved once and trusted everywhere.
functions.notes: Unlocks surveying, architecture, optics and mechanics.

functions.name: Crop rotation
functions.mechanism: The same crop on the same ground yields less every year, as it uses up what it needs and its pests build up. Alternating grain with beans or clover, which restore the soil, and with grazing that manures it, keeps yields up without leaving land idle.
functions.notes: Raises Grain yield and ends wasted fallow years.

functions.name: Irrigation digging
functions.mechanism: Lead water from a river along channels with a slight, steady fall, with gates to flood each plot in turn. Too little fall silts the channel, too much scours it.
functions.notes: Infrastructure. Multiplies Grain yield and frees it from rainfall.

functions.name: Annealing
functions.mechanism: Hammering copper hardens it until it cracks, because the crystal grains become jammed with defects. Heating to red lets new unstrained grains grow, restoring softness, so metal can be worked in cycles of hammer and heat.
functions.notes: Unlocks sheet, wire and forged shapes.

functions.name: Cold working
functions.mechanism: Hammer nuggets into sheet and blades, annealing whenever the metal stiffens. No ore chemistry is involved.
functions.notes: Alternative route to Copper. Small scale only.

functions.name: Gold panning
functions.mechanism: Swirl gravel in water. Gold is about seven times denser than sand and stays at the bottom while lighter grains wash over the rim.

functions.name: Bellows making
functions.mechanism: A leather bag between boards with a flap valve draws air in on the upstroke and forces it through a clay nozzle on the downstroke. Two bags worked alternately give a steady blast.

functions.name: Smelting
functions.mechanism: Ores are metals locked to oxygen, carbonate or sulfur. In a charcoal fire starved of air, hot carbon monoxide takes the oxygen and leaves metal. It needs both high heat and a reducing atmosphere, and the rocky waste must melt into a slag that separates from the metal.
functions.notes: Unlocks all ore smelting and makes prospecting meaningful.

functions.name: Forge building
functions.mechanism: A raised open hearth with a side blast makes a small white-hot zone in charcoal. A hard stone or iron block beside it takes the hammer blows.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Furnace building
functions.mechanism: A clay-lined shaft holds charcoal and ore in layers. Air blown in near the base burns charcoal to carbon monoxide, which rises through the charge. The walls keep heat in and outside air out.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Casting
functions.mechanism: Liquid metal fills a cavity and freezes in its shape. The mould must be bone dry or steam explodes, vented so air can escape, and fed from a reservoir because metal shrinks as it freezes.
functions.notes: Unlocks shaped metal goods and repeatable parts.

functions.name: Prospecting
functions.mechanism: Ore bodies show at the surface as coloured stains, rusty caps, unusually heavy pebbles downstream and plants that tolerate metal. Veins follow cracks in the rock and continue underground along the same dip.
functions.notes: Reveals hidden ore deposits. Unlocks mines.

functions.name: Bloomery building
functions.mechanism: A taller, narrower shaft than a copper furnace keeps ore in contact with carbon monoxide longer, which iron needs. A tapping arch at the base lets slag run and the bloom be dragged out.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Horse taming
functions.mechanism: Horses live in ranked herds and accept a dominant leader. Raised from foals among people and handled daily, they learn to carry and pull.
functions.notes: Speed: messengers, scouts and mounted soldiers.

functions.name: Copper smelting
functions.mechanism: Heat breaks the carbonate to copper oxide, and carbon monoxide strips the oxygen. Above 1085 °C the copper melts and sinks beneath the lighter slag.

functions.name: Tin smelting
functions.mechanism: Tin oxide gives up its oxygen to carbon at only moderate heat and the metal melts at 232 °C, running out of the fire before it can re-oxidise.

functions.name: Mould making
functions.mechanism: Shape a pattern in fat or wax, coat it in fine clay, bake so the pattern runs out and leaves a cavity. Two-piece stone or clay moulds can be reused for simple shapes.

functions.name: Bloom smelting
functions.mechanism: Iron melts at 1538 °C, beyond this furnace, so it is reduced while solid at about 1200 °C into a spongy mass soaked with liquid slag. Too hot or too long and it absorbs carbon and turns brittle.

functions.name: Wound dressing
functions.mechanism: Boiled clean linen keeps dirt out and soaks up discharge, pressure stops bleeding, and washing with sour wine or vinegar discourages festering.

functions.name: Alloying
functions.mechanism: One metal dissolved in another distorts the crystal lattice so its layers cannot slip easily, making the mix harder than either parent. It also melts lower and pours better. Properties depend on proportion, so the charge must be weighed.
functions.notes: Unlocks bronze, brass, solder, type metal and alloy steels.

functions.name: Bloom forging
functions.mechanism: Hammer the bloom at welding heat. Blows squeeze out molten slag and weld the iron grains together. Folding and re-welding spreads the remaining slag into fine threads.

functions.name: Weights and measures
functions.mechanism: Units are defined by physical masters, such as a rod or a set of stones, and working copies are checked against them. An equal-arm balance compares masses regardless of shape, so recipes can be fixed by proportion and repeated.
functions.notes: Unlocks reproducible recipes, assay and fair trade.

functions.name: Bronze founding
functions.mechanism: Melt copper under a charcoal cover to keep air off, then stir in about one part tin to nine of copper. More tin gives a harder but more brittle metal.

functions.name: Carburization and quenching
functions.mechanism: Iron held in glowing charcoal slowly soaks up carbon and becomes steel. Quenching steel from red heat traps the carbon in a strained crystal form that is extremely hard but brittle, and gentle reheating trades some hardness for toughness.
functions.notes: Unlocks steel edges, springs and files.

functions.name: Scale making
functions.mechanism: A beam pivoted exactly at its centre with pans hung at equal distances rests level only when the two loads are equal. Graded stone weights are matched to a master set.
functions.notes: Means of production for anything mixed by proportion.

functions.name: Bronze toolmaking
functions.mechanism: Cast axes, adzes, chisels, saws and picks, then hammer the edges cold to harden them. Metal tools hold an edge and can be recast when worn, unlike stone.
functions.notes: Means of production for carpentry, masonry and mining.

functions.name: Cementation
functions.mechanism: Pack iron bars in charcoal dust inside a sealed clay chest and hold at red heat for days. Carbon diffuses inward. The surface blisters, and the bars are forged together to even out the carbon.

functions.name: Shaft sinking
functions.mechanism: Follow the vein down. Timber frames hold the roof, a fire set against the face and quenched with water cracks hard rock, a windlass lifts ore, and a second shaft makes air circulate.
functions.notes: Infrastructure. Access to underground resources.

functions.name: Blacksmithing
functions.mechanism: Forge iron bodies and weld on steel edges, then quench and temper. Axes, saws, hammers, tongs, chisels, picks, drills and files. Files let metal be shaped by removing it precisely.
functions.notes: Means of production for nearly all later construction.

functions.name: Cart building
functions.mechanism: Two wheels on a fixed axle under a framed bed, drawn by a yoked ox. One animal moves on wheels what ten men could carry.
functions.notes: Means of production for bulk haulage.

functions.name: Anatomy
functions.mechanism: The body is built of distinct organs in constant positions: bones worked as levers by muscles, vessels full of blood, cords running from the brain. It is learned by systematic dissection and drawing, and animals are built much like people.
functions.notes: Unlocks surgery. The basis of physiology.

functions.name: Boatbuilding
functions.mechanism: Join planks edge to edge with pegs or stitching and pack the seams with fibre and tar. A square sail on a mast runs before the wind and an oar over the stern steers.

functions.name: Quarrying
functions.mechanism: Split rock along its natural beds with rows of wedges, dress the faces square with chisels, and move blocks on rollers and sledges.

functions.name: Tack making
functions.mechanism: A bar in the gap between the horse's teeth, worked by reins, steers it. A padded frame spreads the rider's weight off the spine, and loops for the feet let the rider brace.
functions.notes: Mounted riders: couriers and cavalry.

functions.name: Lead smelting
functions.mechanism: Roast the sulfide in air so sulfur burns off as gas and leaves lead oxide, then reduce with charcoal. Lead melts at 327 °C and runs out easily.
functions.notes: The lead carries the ore's silver.

functions.name: Plough making
functions.mechanism: An iron blade cuts a slice of soil and a curved board turns it over, burying weeds and bringing up fresh earth. An ox team supplies a pull no digger can.
functions.notes: Opens heavy, fertile soils that a hoe cannot work.

functions.name: Surgical instrument making
functions.mechanism: Cast and hone scalpels, probes, forceps, needles and bone saws. A smooth metal edge cuts cleanly and can be scoured.

functions.name: Road paving
functions.mechanism: Lay large stones as a foundation, graded gravel above, and a tight arched surface with ditches either side. Water is what destroys a road, so the build is about drainage.
functions.notes: Infrastructure. Carts and armies move in all weather.

functions.name: Cupellation
functions.mechanism: Melt silver-bearing lead on a bed of bone ash under an air blast. Lead oxidises to molten litharge that soaks into the ash, while silver does not oxidise and is left as a bead.

functions.name: Infirmary building
functions.mechanism: A clean, sheltered place where the injured are kept still, wounds are closed, fractures splinted in line, and abscesses drained.
functions.notes: Station. The wounded recover instead of dying.

functions.name: Solubility and crystallization
functions.mechanism: Water dissolves a solid only up to a limit, and usually more when hot. Evaporating or cooling a full solution forces crystals out, and different salts come out at different points, so a mixture can be separated. Whatever will not dissolve is filtered off.
functions.notes: Unlocks purification of salts. Later: crystal growth.

functions.name: Water power
functions.mechanism: Falling water delivers work in proportion to its flow and the height it drops. Paddles or buckets on a wheel turn that into shaft rotation. Catching the water's weight at the top wastes far less than slapping paddles in a current.
functions.notes: Unlocks mills, the first prime mover beyond muscle.

functions.name: Evaporation and condensation
functions.mechanism: Heated liquid turns to vapour and vapour turns back to liquid on a cool surface. Different substances boil at different temperatures, so the first vapour from a mixture is richer in the more volatile part. Dissolved solids stay behind.
functions.notes: Unlocks distillation of spirits, acids, mercury, zinc, and later petroleum and air.

functions.name: Potash boiling
functions.mechanism: Trickle water through ash, strain through cloth, and boil the liquor dry. The soluble potassium carbonate comes through and the insoluble lime and grit stay behind.

functions.name: Calcination
functions.mechanism: Limestone held at about 900 °C gives off an invisible gas and leaves quicklime, lighter and caustic. Quicklime takes up water with fierce heat, and slaked lime slowly reabsorbs the same gas from air and turns back to stone, which is why mortar sets.
functions.notes: Unlocks lime, mortar, cement, glass and furnace fluxes.

functions.name: Vitrification
functions.mechanism: Pure sand melts near 1700 °C, but alkali breaks up its structure so it melts near 1100 °C. Lime makes the result resist water. Cooled faster than crystals can form, it stays a rigid liquid, glass, and softens gradually so it can be worked hot.
functions.notes: Unlocks glass, glazes and enamels.

functions.name: Soap boiling
functions.mechanism: Boiling fat with lye splits it into soap and a sweet syrup, glycerol. Each soap molecule has one end that clings to grease and one that clings to water, so grease is lifted off and rinsed away.

functions.name: Lime burning
functions.mechanism: Stack broken limestone with fuel and burn for a day or more. Lumps must be small enough for the gas to escape from their centres.

functions.name: Ink making
functions.mechanism: Grind soot or charcoal to the finest powder and bind it with glue. Carbon does not fade or react, and the glue holds it to the page.

functions.name: Lime slaking
functions.mechanism: Add quicklime to water, never the reverse. It hisses, swells and falls to a fine white paste of calcium hydroxide, a strong alkali.

functions.name: Mortar mixing
functions.mechanism: Lime paste coats the sand grains and hardens by drawing carbon dioxide from the air, forming limestone again between the grains. Sand provides bulk and stops shrinkage cracks.

functions.name: Papermaking
functions.mechanism: Rot and beat rags until the cellulose fibres separate and fray, float them in water, and lift a thin mat on a screen. As it dries the fibres bond to each other. A dip in glue stops ink feathering.

functions.name: Blowpipe forging
functions.mechanism: Roll iron strip round a rod and weld the seam into a tube about arm's length, long enough to keep the worker's face from the heat.

functions.name: Recorded scholarship
functions.mechanism: Cheap, durable copies let observations pile up, be compared across places and generations, and be corrected by people who never meet. Knowledge stops depending on any one memory.
functions.notes: Theoretical functions become cheaper and tradeable between societies.

functions.name: Magnetism
functions.mechanism: Lodestone pulls iron and passes its power to an iron needle stroked with it. A freely hung needle settles north–south. Like ends repel and unlike attract, and cutting a magnet makes two whole magnets, never a single pole.
functions.notes: Unlocks the compass. One half of electromagnetism.

functions.name: Arch and vault
functions.mechanism: Stone and brick are strong when squeezed and weak when bent. Wedge-shaped blocks set in a curve turn the load into pure squeezing that flows round to the supports, which must resist being pushed apart. The arch is built over a timber form that is removed once the last block locks it.
functions.notes: Unlocks bridges, aqueducts, domes and large halls.

functions.name: Trigonometry
functions.mechanism: In a right-angled triangle the ratios of the sides depend only on the angle. Tabulate those ratios once, and one measured side plus the angles gives every other distance, including heights, river widths and positions in the sky.
functions.notes: Unlocks surveying, navigation, mapmaking and gunnery.

functions.name: Still making
functions.mechanism: A closed copper pot, a domed head to collect vapour, and a long tube cooled by water to condense it. Joints are sealed with clay so nothing escapes.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Glass furnace building
functions.mechanism: A domed chamber with a firebox below and working holes at pot level holds crucibles at steady white heat for days. A cooler side chamber lets finished ware cool slowly.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Gear cutting
functions.mechanism: Pegs on one wheel push the rungs of another. The ratio of tooth counts sets the ratio of speeds, and force changes inversely, so a slow strong wheel can drive a fast light one or turn a corner.

functions.name: Press building
functions.mechanism: A screw is a ramp wrapped round a cylinder. A long handle turned through a wide arc advances the plate a tiny distance with enormous force.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Spirit distilling
functions.mechanism: Alcohol boils at 78 °C and water at 100 °C, so gentle heating drives off vapour rich in alcohol. Repeating the distillation concentrates it further.
functions.notes: Solvent, clean-burning fuel and preservative.

functions.name: Brass making
functions.mechanism: Heat copper with roasted zinc ore and charcoal in a sealed crucible. Zinc boils at 907 °C, below the heat needed to free it, so it must be absorbed into the copper as vapour before it escapes.
functions.notes: Machines well, resists corrosion. The metal of instruments.

functions.name: Draw plate making
functions.mechanism: Punch a row of tapering holes of decreasing size through a steel plate, then harden it. The die must be harder than the metal pulled through it.

functions.name: Lathe building
functions.mechanism: A cord wrapped round the work runs from a springy pole to a treadle and spins it between two iron points. A tool held on a rest cuts a true circle because the work turns about a fixed axis.
functions.notes: Station. Makes round parts: axles, screws, lens tools.

functions.name: Pump making
functions.mechanism: A leather-sealed piston with a flap valve is lifted in a bored log. Water follows the piston up and a second valve stops it falling back.
functions.notes: Curiously, it never lifts water more than about 10 m, however good the seal.

functions.name: Arch bridge building
functions.mechanism: Found the piers inside timber enclosures bailed dry, spring arches between them over timber forms, and fill above to a level roadway.
functions.notes: Infrastructure. Permanent river crossings.

functions.name: Fortification building
functions.mechanism: A thick wall with a rubble core between dressed faces, towers that project so defenders can see along its foot, and a gate as the only weak point.
functions.notes: Infrastructure. A small garrison holds off a large force.

functions.name: Wagon building
functions.mechanism: Four spoked wheels with iron tyres shrunk on hot, a front axle that pivots to steer, and a rigid padded collar that lets a horse pull with its shoulders without choking.
functions.notes: Faster overland haulage than the ox cart.

functions.name: Shipyard building
functions.mechanism: A sloping slipway beside deep water, with sawpits, a steaming trough for bending planks, and a floor on which hull curves are drawn full size.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Glass melting
functions.mechanism: Roast the mixed batch first so gases escape, then melt until bubbles rise out. Roughly six parts sand, two alkali, one lime. Iron in the sand tints it green.

functions.name: Millwrighting
functions.mechanism: A channel leads water from upstream to the top of a bucket wheel on an iron-shod shaft. Gearing matches its slow turn to the machine it drives.
functions.notes: Station. Requires a Flowing river site. A windmill is the equivalent where there is wind and no stream.

functions.name: Wire drawing
functions.mechanism: Pull a greased rod through successively smaller holes. Each pass squeezes it thinner and longer, and hardens it, so it is annealed between passes.

functions.name: Compass making
functions.mechanism: Stroke a hardened steel needle with lodestone and balance it on a pin in a brass case. Steel keeps its magnetism where soft iron loses it.

functions.name: Solder making
functions.mechanism: A mix of about 60% tin and 40% lead melts at 183 °C, below either metal alone, and wets copper. Resin flux dissolves the oxide film so the solder bonds to the metal.

functions.name: Tincture making
functions.mechanism: Spirit dissolves the poppy's active substances better than water and keeps them from spoiling. A measured, strong painkiller, and addictive.

functions.name: Aqueduct building
functions.mechanism: Water runs by gravity down a lined, covered channel surveyed to a steady slope of a fraction of a percent, carried over valleys on arches or through them in sealed lead pipes.
functions.notes: Infrastructure. A city is no longer limited by its wells.

functions.name: Windmill building
functions.mechanism: Sails set at an angle to the wind are pushed sideways and turn a shaft. The top is swung to face the wind, and cloth is furled as it strengthens.
functions.notes: Station. Power where there is wind and no stream.

functions.name: Merchant ship building
functions.mechanism: Set up the keel and ribs first, then nail on the planking. Heavy ballast low in the hull keeps it upright under sail.
functions.notes: Sea trade in bulk goods.

functions.name: Glassblowing
functions.mechanism: Gather molten glass on the pipe and blow. Air pressure stretches it into a thin even bubble that is shaped by swinging, rolling and tools. It must cool slowly or locked-in stress shatters it.
functions.notes: Flasks, retorts, tubes, bulbs. Transparent, inert vessels are what make chemistry observable.

functions.name: Plate casting
functions.mechanism: Pour molten glass on an iron table, roll it flat, cool slowly, then grind both faces with wet sand and polish. Flatness comes from grinding, not from the pour.

functions.name: Grist milling
functions.mechanism: Geared up from the wheel, a heavy upper stone turns over a fixed lower one. Grooves cut in both shear the grain and sweep the meal outward.
functions.notes: Alternative bulk route to Flour.

functions.name: Oxidizer–fuel combustion
functions.mechanism: Saltpetre thrown on embers makes them flare because it carries its own supply of what fire takes from air, locked in solid form. Mixed intimately with fuel it burns without any air at all, at a rate set by how fine the grains are, and turns to hot gas many hundreds of times its volume.
functions.notes: Unlocks black powder and all later propellants and explosives.

functions.name: Saltpetre refining
functions.mechanism: Dissolve crude niter and add potash, which swaps its potassium for the calcium and drops chalk as sludge. Potassium nitrate is far more soluble hot than cold while common salt is not, so cooling the strained liquor yields needle crystals and leaves salt dissolved.

functions.name: Porcelain firing
functions.mechanism: White clay with ground quartz and a fusible stone, fired near 1300 °C. Part of the body melts to glass and fills the pores, leaving it white, translucent, watertight and an electrical insulator.

functions.name: Nitre bed farming
functions.mechanism: Pile dung, earth, ash and lime under a roof, keep it moist with urine and turn it for a year. Soil organisms convert the nitrogen in the waste to nitrate. Leach the heap, treat with ash lye and crystallize.
functions.notes: Alternative route to Potassium nitrate where no natural niter exists. Slow.

functions.name: Acids, bases and salts
functions.mechanism: Sour substances dissolve metals and make limestone fizz. Slippery caustic ones, such as lye and lime, attack flesh and fats. Each destroys the other's properties, and the product is a salt. Certain plant dyes change colour to show which is in excess.
functions.notes: Unlocks mineral acids, assaying and the alkali trade.

functions.name: Algebra
functions.mechanism: Letters stand for unknown or general quantities, and equations are rearranged by rules that keep both sides equal, giving solutions that work for every case at once. Coordinates turn shapes into equations and back.
functions.notes: Unlocks quantitative laws of nature.

functions.name: Hot-air balloon making
functions.mechanism: Heated air expands and weighs less than the cold air round it, so an envelope full of it is pushed up like a cork in water. Paper-lined cloth holds the air and a fire beneath keeps it hot.
functions.notes: First human flight. Observation from above.

functions.name: Black powder
functions.mechanism: Weigh 75 parts saltpetre, 15 charcoal, 10 sulfur. Saltpetre supplies the oxygen, charcoal is the fuel, sulfur lowers the ignition point and speeds the burn. Grind each alone, then mill together damp so grains are pressed into contact and no spark can light the dust.

functions.name: Internal ballistics
functions.mechanism: Powder burned in a closed space raises gas pressure until something gives. In a tube sealed by a projectile, pressure on the base pushes it the whole length of the bore, so a longer barrel and tighter fit give more speed. The wall must be thick enough to hold peak pressure.
functions.notes: Unlocks guns. Plants the idea of a piston driven in a cylinder.

functions.name: Rocket (rudimentary)
functions.mechanism: Ram powder into a glued paper tube with a clay throat and a hollow core down the middle. Gas rushing backward through the throat pushes the tube forward. The core gives a large burning surface and a long stick keeps it pointing straight.

functions.name: Musket making
functions.mechanism: Weld an iron strip round a rod into a tube and ream the bore true. In the lock a flint strikes a hardened steel plate, shaving off white-hot sparks into a pan of priming powder.

functions.name: Mercury roasting
functions.mechanism: Heat the red ore in air. Its sulfur burns off and the mercury leaves as vapour, which condenses in a cooled vessel as liquid metal.
functions.notes: The vapour is poisonous.

functions.name: Blast furnace building
functions.mechanism: A masonry stack several times a man's height, lined with firebrick, charged from the top and blown hard at the base. The height preheats the descending charge and gives iron time to absorb carbon.
functions.notes: Station. Runs continuously for months.

functions.name: Arsenic subliming
functions.mechanism: Heat the ore without air. Arsenic passes straight from solid to vapour and condenses on a cool surface as grey crystals.
functions.notes: Highly poisonous.

functions.name: Corning
functions.mechanism: Press the damp mix into a hard cake, break it and sieve to even grains. Flame flashes through the gaps between grains and lights the whole charge at once, and the ingredients can no longer settle apart in transport.

functions.name: Cannon founding
functions.mechanism: Cast the barrel muzzle-up in a pit mould round a clay core, so slag and bubbles rise into waste metal at the top that is sawn off. Bronze stretches before it bursts, unlike brittle cast iron.

functions.name: Type casting
functions.mechanism: Punch each letter into brass to make a matrix and cast copies in an adjustable hand mould. The lead–tin alloy melts low, fills fine detail and barely shrinks, so every letter comes out the same height.

functions.name: Timekeeping
functions.mechanism: A pendulum's swing time depends on its length and hardly at all on how wide it swings, so it is a natural time standard. An escapement lets a falling weight give it a small push each swing while the pendulum releases the gears one tooth at a time.
functions.notes: Unlocks clocks, precision gearing and the measurement of rates.

functions.name: Cartridge rolling
functions.mechanism: Cast lead balls in a two-part mould and roll each in a paper tube with a measured powder charge. One packet carries one shot, so every load is the same.

functions.name: Printing press building
functions.mechanism: Lock type in a frame, ink it, lay paper on and press with the screw. Setting a page takes hours but each further copy takes seconds, and the type is reused.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Clockmaking
functions.mechanism: Cut brass wheels with evenly divided teeth, run hardened steel pivots in brass holes, and drive the train by a weight or coiled spring. Even tooth spacing matters more than anything else.
functions.notes: The school of precision mechanics.

functions.name: Pig iron smelting (charcoal)
functions.mechanism: Iron that absorbs about 4% carbon melts at 1150 °C instead of 1538 °C, so it runs liquid from the hearth. Limestone combines with the ore's sand and clay to make a fluid slag that floats on the iron.
functions.notes: Castable but brittle. Water-driven bellows supply the blast.

functions.name: Celestial navigation
functions.mechanism: The height of the pole star or the noon sun above the horizon gives latitude directly. Longitude is a time difference: the Earth turns 15° an hour, so comparing local noon with a clock still keeping home time gives position east or west.
functions.notes: Unlocks open-ocean voyages and the return to any known place.

functions.name: Spin stabilization
functions.mechanism: A ball from a smooth bore leaves with random spin and curves unpredictably. Spiral grooves that grip the shot make it spin about its line of flight, and a spinning body resists being tipped, so it flies true. The tight fit that grips also seals the gas.
functions.notes: Unlocks rifles. The gyroscope principle.

functions.name: Printing
functions.mechanism: Oily ink sticks to metal type where watery ink would bead. Identical copies mean every reader sees the same figures and tables, so errors can be found and corrected in the next edition.

functions.name: Optics
functions.mechanism: Light travels in straight lines and bends by a fixed rule on entering glass or water, so a curved surface brings parallel rays to a focus. A prism spreads white light into colours because each colour bends by a different amount.
functions.notes: Unlocks lenses, instruments and, much later, lithography.

functions.name: Sulfuric acid (bell process)
functions.mechanism: Burn sulfur with a little saltpetre under a glass bell over water. The saltpetre helps the sulfur fumes take up extra oxygen, and the result dissolves in the water as a heavy oily acid that is concentrated by boiling.
functions.notes: Small scale. The most important industrial chemical.

functions.name: Nitric acid (retort)
functions.mechanism: Heat saltpetre with sulfuric acid in a glass retort. The stronger, less volatile acid displaces the nitric acid, which distils over as fuming vapour.
functions.notes: Dissolves silver but not gold.

functions.name: Hydrochloric acid
functions.mechanism: Sulfuric acid on common salt drives off a choking gas that dissolves eagerly in water to give the acid. A solid salt cake is left behind.

functions.name: Fining
functions.mechanism: Remelt pig iron in an air blast. The carbon burns out, the melting point rises, and the iron stiffens into a pasty ball that is hammered under a water-driven hammer.
functions.notes: Alternative bulk route to Wrought iron.

functions.name: Chronometer making
functions.mechanism: A balance wheel and spring replace the pendulum, which a ship's motion would upset. A rim of two metals corrects for temperature, and the whole hangs level in pivoted rings.
functions.notes: Longitude at sea to within a few miles.

functions.name: Ocean ship building
functions.mechanism: Several masts carrying both square and triangular sails let it work against the wind. A hinged stern rudder steers, copper sheathing keeps borers and weed off the hull, and a deep hold carries months of stores.
functions.notes: Transoceanic exploration, trade and colonies.

functions.name: Rifle making
functions.mechanism: A cutter on a rod guided by a spiral template is drawn through the bore again and again, deepening the grooves a hair each pass. Uniform twist is what gives accuracy.

functions.name: Scientific method
functions.mechanism: A claim about nature is tested by an experiment that changes one thing at a time, measures the result in numbers, and is described fully enough for strangers to repeat. Explanations must predict quantities, and are dropped when measurement disagrees.
functions.notes: Required by most later theory. Speeds every theoretical function.

functions.name: Lens grinding
functions.mechanism: Rub a glass disc against a curved iron tool with wet grit of finer and finer grade, then polish on pitch. Random rubbing between two surfaces naturally produces a sphere, which is why spherical lenses could be made by hand.

functions.name: Contagion and quarantine
functions.mechanism: Some diseases pass from the sick to the well through contact, goods or breath, after a delay. Holding arrivals apart for longer than that delay stops the spread, without knowing what is passed.
functions.notes: Limits plagues in ports and cities. Needed for dense trade.

functions.name: Microscope making
functions.mechanism: A small strongly curved lens forms an enlarged image of a near object, and a second lens magnifies that image again. Brass tubes hold the spacing and a screw sets focus.
functions.notes: Means of production for fine inspection and assembly.

functions.name: Telescope making
functions.mechanism: A large weak lens gathers light from a distant object to a focus and a small strong lens magnifies that image. Magnification is the ratio of the two focal lengths.

functions.name: Atmospheric pressure and vacuum
functions.mechanism: Air has weight. The ocean of air presses on everything hard enough to hold up 10 m of water or 76 cm of mercury, which is why suction pumps fail beyond that height. The space above the mercury in a sealed tube holds nothing, and an emptied vessel lets the atmosphere do work.
functions.notes: Unlocks the barometer, air pump, steam engine and all vacuum technology.

functions.name: Circulation of the blood
functions.mechanism: The heart is a pump and the valves in it and in the veins allow flow one way only. The amount it moves in an hour far exceeds anything food could supply, so the same blood must travel a closed loop, out by arteries and back by veins.
functions.notes: Unlocks physiology, injection and transfusion.

functions.name: Nutrition and deficiency disease
functions.mechanism: Give matched groups of sick sailors different additions to the same diet and only those given citrus recover. Some diseases come from the lack of a small amount of something in fresh food, which long storage destroys.
functions.notes: Long voyages and sieges without scurvy. Later: vitamins.

functions.name: Classical mechanics
functions.mechanism: A body keeps its speed and direction unless a force acts. Force equals mass times acceleration, and every push has an equal push back. One law of gravity, weakening with the square of distance, governs both a cannonball and the moon.
functions.notes: Unlocks engineering calculation for structures, machines and trajectories.

functions.name: Barometer making
functions.mechanism: Fill a glass tube sealed at one end with mercury and upend it in a dish. The column falls to about 76 cm and its height follows the air pressure.

functions.name: Air pump making
functions.mechanism: A piston in a bored brass cylinder with greased leather seals and two valves removes a fixed fraction of the remaining air each stroke from a glass vessel.

functions.name: Microscopic life
functions.mechanism: Pond water, tooth scrapings and fermenting liquids swarm with living things too small to see. Larger creatures are built of cells, and every cell comes from an earlier cell.
functions.notes: Unlocks germ theory and cell biology.

functions.name: Theodolite making
functions.mechanism: A telescope pivoting over two finely divided circles reads horizontal and vertical angles to a small fraction of a degree. A bubble in a spirit-filled tube shows true level.

functions.name: Sextant making
functions.mechanism: Two mirrors bring the image of the sun or a star down to touch the horizon, and the angle is read off a divided arc. Both images move together, so it works on a rolling deck.

functions.name: Calculus
functions.mechanism: A changing quantity has a rate of change at every instant, found as the limit of ever smaller steps, and a total is the sum of infinitely many thin slices. The two operations undo each other, which turns laws about rates into predictions.
functions.notes: Unlocks thermodynamics, electromagnetism and all later physics.

functions.name: Map surveying
functions.mechanism: Measure one baseline with great care, then only angles. A chain of triangles spreads from it and fixes every hilltop and tower in the country.
functions.notes: Roads, canals, taxes and campaigns planned on paper.

functions.name: Canal building
functions.mechanism: A level channel lined with kneaded clay to hold water. Locks, chambers with a gate at each end, raise and lower boats by filling and emptying.
functions.notes: Infrastructure. One horse hauls thirty times more on water than by road.

functions.name: Land drainage
functions.mechanism: Enclose marsh or shallows with an earth bank and lift the water over it continuously with wind-driven scoop wheels into a ring canal.
functions.notes: Infrastructure. New farmland from fen and sea.

functions.name: Coke oven building
functions.mechanism: A sealed brick chamber heated from outside, with pipes to lead off the gases and tar instead of letting them burn.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Wood distilling
functions.mechanism: Char wood in a closed iron retort and condense the smoke. The watery layer holds wood spirit and acetic acid, separated by redistilling.
functions.notes: Alternative route to Charcoal that keeps the vapours.

functions.name: Coking
functions.mechanism: Bake coal without air. Sulfurous and tarry matter is driven off, leaving hard porous carbon strong enough to carry the weight of a tall furnace charge without crushing. Washing the gas with water collects ammonia.
functions.notes: Frees iron from the forest. Coal gas lights streets. Coal tar founds organic chemistry. A first, small-scale route to Ammonia.

functions.name: Lead chamber building
functions.mechanism: Room-sized boxes of lead sheet on a timber frame, joined by melting the lead itself. Lead forms an insoluble skin that the acid cannot penetrate.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Seed drill making
functions.mechanism: A wheel-driven feed drops seeds one at a time down tubes into furrows of even depth and covers them. Straight rows waste less seed and can be hoed between.
functions.notes: Raises Grain yield per seed sown.

functions.name: Crucible steel melting
functions.mechanism: Melt blister steel completely in a sealed fireclay pot in a coke fire with a tall chimney draft. Melting evens out the carbon and lets slag float off, giving uniform steel that takes and keeps a fine edge.
functions.notes: Tool steel for cutters, dies, springs and gauges.

functions.name: Sulfuric acid (lead chamber)
functions.mechanism: Burn sulfur and lead the fumes into the chambers with steam and nitre fumes. The nitre gases pass oxygen from the air to the sulfur gas over and over without being used up.
functions.notes: Alternative, tonnage route to Sulfuric acid.

functions.name: Zinc smelting
functions.mechanism: Zinc is freed from its ore only above its own boiling point, so it comes off as vapour and burns if it meets air. Heat the charge in a closed clay retort and lead the vapour into a cool receiver where it condenses.
functions.notes: The residue holds traces of rarer metals.

functions.name: Boring mill building
functions.mechanism: A stiff bar carrying the cutter is supported at both ends and passes right through the cylinder, so it cannot droop or follow the errors of the rough casting. The bore comes out round and parallel.
functions.notes: Station. The first machine tool accurate enough for engine cylinders.

functions.name: Precision and interchangeability
functions.mechanism: If every part is made to a shared standard within a stated tolerance, any part fits any assembly without hand fitting. That needs master references for flat, straight, square and length that are generated from first principles, and gauges copied from them.
functions.notes: Unlocks machine tools and mass production.

functions.name: Leblanc soda process
functions.mechanism: Roast salt cake with limestone and coal. Coal strips the oxygen from the sulfate, and the limestone swaps its carbonate for the sulfur. Soda is washed out of the black ash with water.
functions.notes: Alkali without burning forests.

functions.name: Optical glass melting
functions.mechanism: Melt very pure batch and stir it continuously as it cools so it is uniform throughout, with no streaks or bubbles. Lead oxide gives a dense glass that spreads colours strongly, borax a light one that spreads them weakly.

functions.name: Surface plate scraping
functions.mechanism: Rub three cast plates against each other in rotating pairs with marking ink and scrape off the high spots. Two plates can match while being curved, but three can only all match each other if all are truly flat.
functions.notes: Flatness created from nothing. The reference for all later precision.

functions.name: Causticizing
functions.mechanism: Boil soda solution with slaked lime. Chalk settles out and the liquor left is caustic soda, a far stronger alkali.

functions.name: Vulcanization
functions.mechanism: Raw rubber is sticky when warm and brittle when cold. Heated with sulfur, its long chain molecules are tied to each other at intervals, so it springs back at any temperature.
functions.notes: Seals, hoses, belts and electrical insulation.

functions.name: Spectroscope making
functions.mechanism: Light through a narrow slit is made parallel by a lens, spread by a prism and viewed through a small telescope against a scale, so each colour's position can be measured.

functions.name: Inoculation and immunity
functions.mechanism: Survivors of certain diseases never catch them again. Deliberately giving a mild related infection, such as cowpox scratched into the skin, leaves the body able to resist the deadly one.
functions.notes: Unlocks vaccination.

functions.name: Epidemiology
functions.mechanism: Plot cases on a map and count them by water source, street and trade. The pattern points to the source of an outbreak even when the agent is unseen, and comparing rates between exposed and unexposed groups tests the suspicion.
functions.notes: Unlocks public sanitation.

functions.name: Engine lathe building
functions.mechanism: A rigid iron bed scraped straight, a tool held in a sliding rest instead of the hand, and a lead screw geared to the spindle. The machine can then cut screws more accurate than its own lead screw and so improve itself.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Smallpox vaccination
functions.mechanism: Take fluid from a cowpox blister on a calf, keep it in sealed glass tubes, and scratch it into the arm.
functions.notes: Removes the single largest killer. Populations and armies stop being periodically devastated.

functions.name: Metallography
functions.mechanism: Polish metal, etch it lightly with acid and look through a microscope. Metals are built of crystal grains, and steel of distinct constituents whose proportions and fineness follow the carbon content and the cooling history. Hardness and toughness can be predicted from that structure.
functions.notes: Heat treatment becomes a controlled science. Unlocks designed alloys.

functions.name: Heat and steam
functions.mechanism: Water boiled to steam takes about 1600 times the space. Condensing that steam inside a closed cylinder leaves a vacuum, and the atmosphere drives the piston in. Boiling absorbs a great deal of heat without getting hotter, so cooling and reheating the cylinder each stroke wastes most of the fuel.
functions.notes: Unlocks steam engines.

functions.name: Gauge making
functions.mechanism: A fine accurate screw turns a small length into many turns of a divided drum, reading to a thousandth of an inch. Hardened plugs and rings ground to size check parts as go or no-go.

functions.name: Milling machine building
functions.mechanism: A rotating many-toothed cutter removes metal while the work is fed past on screw-driven slides, producing flat and profiled surfaces that would otherwise be filed by hand.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Chemical elements and conservation of mass
functions.mechanism: Weigh everything, including gases, in sealed vessels and the total never changes. Burning and rusting are a substance combining with one part of the air, oxygen, and gaining its weight. Substances that cannot be broken down further are elements.
functions.notes: Unlocks quantitative chemistry. Reveals several ores as sources of new metals.

functions.name: Germ theory of disease
functions.mechanism: Boiled broth in a flask whose bent neck lets air in but traps dust stays clear indefinitely, so microbes come only from other microbes. Particular microbes cause particular fermentations and particular diseases: found in every case, grown pure outside the body, and able to cause the disease again.
functions.notes: Unlocks antisepsis, sterilisation, sanitation, vaccines and antibiotics.

functions.name: Gas laws
functions.mechanism: For a fixed amount of gas, pressure times volume stays constant at constant temperature, and volume grows in step with temperature. Extended downward, the line points to an absolute zero.
functions.notes: Unlocks gas balloons and the design of engines and compressors.

functions.name: Atmospheric engine building
functions.mechanism: Steam from a copper boiler fills a brass cylinder under a piston. A spray of cold water condenses it and air pressure pushes the piston down, pulling a rocking beam that works a pump rod.
functions.notes: Station. Wasteful of fuel, so it lives at coal mines.

functions.name: Steam engine building
functions.mechanism: Condense the steam in a separate vessel kept cold so the cylinder stays hot, and let steam push on both sides of a piston in an accurately bored cylinder. A crank and flywheel turn the strokes into smooth rotation.
functions.notes: Station. Power anywhere fuel can be brought.

functions.name: Laboratory fitting
functions.mechanism: Benches, a draught hood, a precise balance, glass apparatus that can be sealed and heated, and a clean alcohol flame. Everything in and out of a reaction can be contained and weighed.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Spectroscopy
functions.mechanism: Each element heated in a flame gives out its own set of sharp coloured lines, and absorbs the same lines from light passing through it. The pattern is a fingerprint that detects a trace too small to weigh, on the bench or in the sun.
functions.notes: Detects unknown elements and measures purity. Evidence for quantum theory.

functions.name: Hydrogen from acid
functions.mechanism: Iron dissolving in dilute acid displaces a gas fourteen times lighter than air, collected over water.
functions.notes: Alternative early route to Hydrogen.

functions.name: Fluid mechanics
functions.mechanism: Where a flowing fluid speeds up its pressure falls. Through any pipe, area times speed is constant. Resistance grows with the square of speed. Pressure in a confined fluid acts equally in all directions, so a small piston can move a large one.
functions.notes: Unlocks turbines, pumps, hydraulics and aerodynamics.

functions.name: Strength of materials
functions.mechanism: A material stretches in proportion to its load up to a limit, then yields or breaks at a characteristic stress. A loaded beam is squeezed along one edge and stretched along the other, so depth matters far more than width. Slender columns fail by bowing sideways. Sizes can be calculated before building.
functions.notes: Unlocks engineered iron and steel structures.

functions.name: Pig iron smelting (coke)
functions.mechanism: Coke replaces charcoal as both fuel and reducing agent. Being stronger, it allows taller furnaces and harder blast, driven by steam blowing engines.
functions.notes: Alternative, scalable route to Pig iron.

functions.name: Deep mining
functions.mechanism: Below the water table a mine floods faster than men or horses can bail. An engine working pumps in stages down the shaft keeps the lower levels dry.
functions.notes: Infrastructure. Access to deep resources.

functions.name: Machine shop building
functions.mechanism: Machine tools driven by belts from an overhead shaft turned by one engine, with shared gauges, so parts made by different hands on different days interchange.
functions.notes: Station. The means of production for every later machine.

functions.name: Cement burning
functions.mechanism: Burn ground limestone and clay together at about 1450 °C until they partly fuse, then grind the clinker. The calcium silicates formed react with water into interlocking crystals, hardening even under water.

functions.name: Atomic theory and stoichiometry
functions.mechanism: Elements always combine in fixed weight ratios that are small whole-number multiples, as if matter were atoms each with a characteristic weight. Formulas and balanced equations then predict exactly how much of each reagent yields how much product.
functions.notes: Recipes stop wasting material. Unlocks industrial chemistry.

functions.name: Thermodynamics
functions.mechanism: Heat is a form of energy, not a substance, and converts to and from work at a fixed rate. It flows on its own only from hot to cold, and the most work any engine can extract depends only on the two temperatures it works between. A compressed gas cools when it expands through a throttle.
functions.notes: Raises the efficiency of every engine. Unlocks turbines, refrigeration and gas liquefaction.

functions.name: Quinine extraction
functions.mechanism: The fever bark's active substance is a base. Free it with lime, dissolve it in spirit, and convert it with acid to a crystalline salt that can be weighed out as a dose.
functions.notes: Makes malarial regions survivable.

functions.name: Diagnostic instrument making
functions.mechanism: Mercury expands evenly with heat in a fine tube, and a pinch in the tube holds the highest reading. A tube from chest to ear carries the sounds of heart and lungs.

functions.name: Gas balloon making
functions.mechanism: Hydrogen is fourteen times lighter than air and lifts about a kilogram per cubic metre. Rubber-proofed cloth holds it, a valve lets gas out to descend and ballast is dropped to rise.

functions.name: Glider building
functions.mechanism: A light braced frame covered in fabric, with curved wings. Launched from a slope, it trades height for the forward speed that keeps air flowing over the wings.

functions.name: Converter building
functions.mechanism: A tilting iron vessel lined with firebrick, with air holes in the base fed from a blowing engine.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Precision lens making
functions.mechanism: Cement a lens of the weakly dispersing glass to one of the strongly dispersing glass, shaped so their colour errors cancel while a net focusing power remains. Surfaces are tested against master curves by the coloured fringes between them.

functions.name: Periodic law
functions.mechanism: Arranged by atomic weight, the elements' properties repeat at regular intervals, falling into families. Gaps in the table predict undiscovered elements and their properties in advance, and the prediction can be checked.
functions.notes: Reveals rarer resources such as germanium and the rare earths. Guides the choice of dopants.

functions.name: Organic chemistry
functions.mechanism: Carbon atoms form four bonds and link into chains and rings. Two substances with the same formula can differ in how the atoms are connected, and properties follow that structure, so useful compounds can be designed and built from simple feedstocks.
functions.notes: Unlocks coal-tar chemicals, dyes, synthetic resins and, later, polymers and photoresists.

functions.name: Sewer building
functions.mechanism: Brick tunnels narrower at the bottom than the top keep even a small flow moving fast enough to scour. A surveyed continuous fall carries waste away, downstream of where drinking water is drawn.
functions.notes: Infrastructure. Ends the cycle of waterborne epidemics, so cities can grow.

functions.name: Bessemer steelmaking
functions.mechanism: Blow cold air through molten pig iron. The carbon and silicon burn and their heat keeps the bath liquid with no extra fuel. Manganese then takes up the dissolved oxygen and sulfur that would make the steel crack.
functions.notes: Steel by the ton in minutes, where crucible steel came by the kilogram.

functions.name: Coal tar distilling
functions.mechanism: Heat tar and collect what boils off in separate temperature ranges: light oils with benzene, middle oils with phenol and naphthalene, and a residue of pitch. Washing a fraction with alkali pulls out the acidic phenol.

functions.name: Formaldehyde making
functions.mechanism: Pass methanol vapour and air over hot silver gauze. The silver helps strip two hydrogens from each molecule, leaving a reactive gas that is caught in water. The silver is not used up.

functions.name: Ether making
functions.mechanism: Hot acid removes water from two alcohol molecules and joins them. The product boils at 35 °C and distils straight over. Its vapour is heavy and extremely flammable.

functions.name: Rolling mill building
functions.mechanism: Pairs of heavy grooved iron rolls geared to an engine squeeze hot metal thinner and longer on each pass.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Concrete pouring
functions.mechanism: Cement paste glues sand and gravel into artificial rock. Concrete resists crushing but cracks when pulled, so steel bars are cast into the stretched side to carry the pull.

functions.name: Phenolic resin making
functions.mechanism: Formaldehyde links phenol rings together into a branching network. With acid and a shortage of formaldehyde the product stays a fusible, soluble resin. With more, heat sets it permanently into a hard insulating solid.
functions.notes: The first fully synthetic plastic.

functions.name: Antiseptic preparation
functions.mechanism: A dilute solution of phenol kills microbes on skin, instruments and dressings. Too strong and it burns the tissue it is meant to protect.

functions.name: Anaesthesia
functions.mechanism: Breathing the vapour of certain volatile liquids removes consciousness and pain, and the effect wears off when it stops. Depth follows the concentration breathed. Too much stops breathing.
functions.notes: Unlocks long, careful surgery.

functions.name: Synthetic dye making
functions.mechanism: Add a nitrogen group to benzene with mixed acids, convert it with iron and acid to aniline, and couple the result into large molecules that absorb strongly and bond to fibre. Small changes of structure change the colour.
functions.notes: Founds the fine-chemicals industry. Also stains for the microscope.

functions.name: Wire rope making
functions.mechanism: Drawing steel wire cold multiplies its strength. Many wires are twisted into strands and the strands into rope, which bends easily and fails one wire at a time instead of all at once.
functions.notes: Hoists, cranes, lifts, suspension bridges.

functions.name: Plate rolling
functions.mechanism: Reheat ingots and pass them repeatedly between rolls. Rolling refines the grain and gives uniform sheet, plate, rail and beam sections.

functions.name: Pipe making
functions.mechanism: Roll strip into a tube and weld the seam at white heat, or pierce a hot billet over a pointed bar for seamless pipe that holds pressure.

functions.name: Tinplate making
functions.mechanism: Clean thin steel sheet in acid and dip it in molten tin. Tin wets the steel and leaves a thin coat that does not rust or taint food.

functions.name: Autoclave building
functions.mechanism: Steam held under pressure reaches about 120 °C, which kills the resistant spores that survive boiling. A sealed vessel with a gauge and safety valve.

functions.name: Steel bridge building
functions.mechanism: Frames of triangles in which every member is either purely pulled or purely pushed span far on little metal. Joints are riveted hot, and the rivets tighten as they cool.
functions.notes: Infrastructure. Railways cross wide rivers and gorges.

functions.name: Chemical plant building
functions.mechanism: Laboratory operations scaled to closed steel vessels, towers and pipework, lined with lead or glass where acids run, with pumps moving liquids continuously instead of in batches.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Drilling rig building
functions.mechanism: An engine raises and drops a heavy steel bit on a cable to pound a hole, which is lined with pipe to stop it caving and to keep groundwater out.
functions.notes: Infrastructure. Access to Crude oil.

functions.name: Refinery building
functions.mechanism: A heated still feeding a tall column with trays at different heights. Each tray sits at its own temperature and collects the part of the oil that condenses there.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Canning
functions.mechanism: Seal food in a tin and then boil it. Whatever spoils food is destroyed by the heat and cannot get back in through the soldered seam.
functions.notes: Food that keeps for years: armies, fleets and cities far from farms.

functions.name: Hospital building
functions.mechanism: Airy wards separated by disease, with instruments and dressings sterilised and operations done painlessly and clean. Opening the abdomen becomes survivable.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Locomotive building
