functions.mechanism: High-pressure steam in a boiler threaded with fire tubes drives pistons coupled directly to the wheels. Exhaust steam blown up the chimney draws the fire harder the faster it runs.

functions.name: Steamship building
functions.mechanism: A riveted steel hull is lighter and can be far larger than a timber one. A screw of angled blades throws water astern, and cross walls divide the hull so one breach cannot flood it.
functions.notes: Voyages on schedule regardless of wind. Burns Coal, so needs fuelling stations along its routes.

functions.name: Petroleum distilling
functions.mechanism: Crude oil is a mixture of molecules of every size. Light ones boil off first and rise highest in the column. Heavy ones stay low and give lubricants that do not gum or go rancid like animal fat.

functions.name: Superphosphate making
functions.mechanism: Rock phosphate does not dissolve, so plants cannot take it up. Acid converts it to a form that dissolves in soil water.
functions.notes: Alternative route to Fertilizer, supplying phosphorus instead of nitrogen.

functions.name: Solvay process
functions.mechanism: Pass carbon dioxide from burning limestone into brine saturated with ammonia. Sodium bicarbonate is the least soluble product and crystallises out, and heating it gives soda ash. The ammonia is recovered with lime and reused.
functions.notes: Alternative, cleaner route to Soda ash.

functions.name: Railway building
functions.mechanism: A steel wheel on a steel rail rolls with a tenth of a road's resistance, so one engine pulls hundreds of tons. The line must be nearly level, which means cuttings, embankments, bridges and tunnels.
functions.notes: Infrastructure. Continental interiors opened. Troops, food and coal move at speed.

functions.name: Boolean logic
functions.mechanism: Reasoning can be done as algebra on just two values, true and false, with the operations AND, OR and NOT. Any logical statement is some combination of them, and numbers written in base two need only the same two symbols.
functions.notes: Unlocks switching circuits and programming.

functions.name: Static electricity
functions.mechanism: Rubbing moves something from one body to another that makes them attract light objects. There are two kinds: like repel and unlike attract. Metals and damp things let it flow, glass and amber hold it, and it can be stored on two metal coatings facing each other across glass.
functions.notes: Unlocks the capacitor and electrostatics.

functions.name: Probability and statistics
functions.mechanism: Chance events settle to stable long-run frequencies that can be calculated. Repeated measurements scatter in a bell shape round the true value, so averages and error bounds can be stated, and a small sample can judge a large batch.
functions.notes: Unlocks quality control, information theory and yield management.

functions.name: Leyden jar making
functions.mechanism: Coat a glass jar inside and out with metal foil and connect the inner coat to a rod through the lid. Charge given to one coat holds an equal opposite charge on the other through the thin glass, storing far more than a bare conductor.
functions.notes: The first capacitor.

functions.name: Genetics
functions.mechanism: Traits are inherited as separate units, one from each parent, that do not blend. Some mask others and reappear unchanged in later generations in fixed ratios, so the outcome of a cross can be predicted by counting.
functions.notes: Unlocks hybrid crops and, later, molecular biology.

functions.name: Hybrid seed breeding
functions.mechanism: Inbreed two lines until each is uniform, then cross them. The first-generation offspring are uniform and far more vigorous than either parent, but the effect fades if their seed is saved, so the cross is remade each year.
functions.notes: Multiplies Grain yield.

functions.name: Electrochemistry
functions.mechanism: Two different metals joined through a salty liquid give a continuous flow of electricity, because the more reactive metal dissolves and gives up charge that travels round to the other. Cells in a stack add up. Run backwards, a current forces chemical change in strict proportion to the charge passed.
functions.notes: Unlocks batteries, electrolysis, electroplating and electrolytic refining.

functions.name: Rocket equation
functions.mechanism: A rocket pushes on its own exhaust, not on the air, so it works in a vacuum. Its final speed is the exhaust speed times the logarithm of its starting mass over its finishing mass, so reaching very high speed means being mostly propellant and discarding empty tanks in stages.
functions.notes: Unlocks liquid-fuel rockets, staging and spaceflight.

functions.name: Voltaic pile
functions.mechanism: Stack copper disc, brine-soaked cloth, zinc disc, and repeat. Each trio adds its push to the last. Zinc is slowly consumed, which is where the energy comes from.
functions.notes: The first steady current.

functions.name: Lead–acid battery making
functions.mechanism: Two lead grids in sulfuric acid. Charging turns one to lead dioxide. Discharging turns both to lead sulfate and releases the stored energy. The reaction reverses cleanly hundreds of times.
functions.notes: Rechargeable storage.

functions.name: Mercury pump making
functions.mechanism: Drops of mercury falling down a narrow glass tube trap slugs of air between them and carry it out. With no piston seals to leak, it reaches a millionth of an atmosphere.

functions.name: Silver nitrate making
functions.mechanism: Dissolve silver in nitric acid and crystallise.

functions.name: Asphalt road building
functions.mechanism: Crushed stone bound with hot bitumen and rolled makes a waterproof, dustless, smooth surface that stands up to rubber tyres at speed.
functions.notes: Infrastructure.

functions.name: Electromagnetism
functions.mechanism: A current in a wire deflects a nearby compass, so moving electricity creates magnetism that circles the wire. Winding the wire into a coil concentrates the effect and an iron core multiplies it. A wire carrying current in a magnet's field is pushed sideways.
functions.notes: Unlocks electromagnets, meters, telegraphs and motors.

functions.name: Chemical equilibrium and catalysis
functions.mechanism: Many reactions run both ways and settle at a balance point that pressure and temperature shift in predictable directions. A catalyst speeds the approach without being used up or moving the balance. Conditions can therefore be calculated to force an unwilling reaction.
functions.notes: Unlocks ammonia synthesis, cracking and the gas-phase deposition used in chipmaking.

functions.name: Calculator making
functions.mechanism: Geared number wheels add by turning. A tooth that trips once per revolution carries one to the next wheel. Multiplication is repeated addition with a shifting carriage.

functions.name: Glass fibre drawing
functions.mechanism: Molten glass runs through hundreds of fine holes in a platinum plate and is pulled away at high speed into filaments thinner than hair. With no surface flaws they are far stronger than bulk glass, and flexible.

functions.name: Wire insulating
functions.mechanism: Wrap the wire in thread or coat it in rubber so adjacent turns of a coil cannot touch. Current must follow every turn for the turns' effects to add.

functions.name: Photochemistry
functions.mechanism: Light absorbed by certain substances drives chemical change. Silver salts darken. A film of bitumen or sensitised gelatin hardens where light falls, so the unexposed part washes away and leaves an image that resists acid. Bluer light is more active.
functions.notes: Unlocks photography and photoengraving, the ancestors of chip lithography.

functions.name: Nitroglycerin making
functions.mechanism: Fuel and oxygen sit in the same molecule, so it does not burn from the surface but decomposes as a shock wave faster than sound, shattering whatever confines it. It is made cold because the reaction heats itself, and a blow sets it off.

functions.name: Electromagnet winding
functions.mechanism: Wind many turns on a soft iron core. Pull is proportional to current times turns. Soft iron loses its magnetism the moment the current stops, so the magnet can be switched.

functions.name: Galvanometer making
functions.mechanism: A coil of many turns round a compass needle multiplies the deflecting effect of a weak current, so the needle's angle measures the current.
functions.notes: The first electrical measuring instrument.

functions.name: Electrode baking
functions.mechanism: Mix ground graphite with pitch, press it into rods and bake so the pitch chars and binds. Graphite conducts electricity and stays solid beyond 3000 °C.

functions.name: Photographic plate coating
functions.mechanism: In the dark, form fine silver halide crystals in warm gelatin and coat it on glass. Light leaves an invisible speck of silver on each exposed crystal, and developer turns only those crystals wholly to silver.
functions.notes: Records fine patterns exactly, and at any reduction.

functions.name: Aspirin synthesis
functions.mechanism: Build the pain-relieving acid of willow bark from phenol and carbon dioxide, then attach an acetyl group, which makes it far kinder to the stomach.
functions.notes: The first mass-produced synthetic drug.

functions.name: Dynamite making
functions.mechanism: Soaked into a porous earth it becomes a putty that survives handling and fires only from a small detonating cap.
functions.notes: Rock excavation multiplied: tunnels, canals, quarries, mines.

functions.name: Tyre making
functions.mechanism: Air under pressure inside fabric-reinforced rubber cushions the wheel. Soot mixed into the rubber multiplies its resistance to wear, and steel wire holds the tyre on the rim.

functions.name: Circuit laws
functions.mechanism: Current through a conductor is its driving voltage divided by its resistance, which rises with length and falls with thickness. Currents meeting at a junction balance, and voltages round any closed loop sum to zero. Power lost as heat is voltage times current.
functions.notes: Unlocks circuit design, long telegraph lines and power distribution.

functions.name: Electromagnetic induction
functions.mechanism: A steady magnet near a coil does nothing, but a changing magnetic field drives a current in it. The voltage depends on how fast the field through the coil changes and on the number of turns. So motion can be turned into electricity, and one coil can induce a voltage in another.
functions.notes: Unlocks generators, transformers and induction heating.

functions.name: Relay making
functions.mechanism: An electromagnet pulls a sprung iron arm that closes a separate pair of silver contacts. A weak current thereby switches a strong one, and one relay can operate others.
functions.notes: A switch worked by electricity: the first logic element.

functions.name: Piezoelectricity
functions.mechanism: Squeezing certain crystals produces a voltage across them, and a voltage makes them flex. A thin slab of quartz rings mechanically at a frequency fixed by its thickness, far more sharply and stably than any coil and capacitor.
functions.notes: Unlocks crystal clocks and ultrasonic transducers.

functions.name: Polymer science
functions.mechanism: Rubber, resins and plant fibres are giant molecules, thousands of small units joined end to end by ordinary chemical bonds. Chain length, branching and cross-links decide whether the material is a liquid, a rubber, a fibre or a rigid solid.
functions.notes: Unlocks plastics, epoxies, synthetic rubber, ion-exchange resins and designed photoresists.

functions.name: Telegraph building
functions.mechanism: A key at one end closes a circuit and an electromagnet at the other clicks. Wire is carried on poles with glass insulators so current does not leak to earth, and the earth itself is the return path.
functions.notes: Messages at the speed of electricity.

functions.name: Generator building
functions.mechanism: Spin coils wound on an iron core between the poles of electromagnets fed by part of the machine's own output. Copper segments and brushes take the current off the moving coils.

functions.name: Motor building
functions.mechanism: A generator run backwards. Current in the rotor coils is pushed sideways by the field, and switching the coils as they turn keeps the push in one direction. The core is built from thin plates to stop wasteful currents circulating in the iron.
functions.notes: Power delivered by wire to each machine.

functions.name: Lamp making
functions.mechanism: Char a thread to a carbon filament, seal it in a bulb pumped to high vacuum so it cannot burn, and pass current to heat it white. The lead-in wire must expand at the same rate as glass or the seal cracks.

functions.name: Resistor making
functions.mechanism: Mix carbon powder with clay in a set proportion, bake it into a rod, fit wire leads and seal. More clay gives more resistance.

functions.name: Electromagnetic waves
functions.mechanism: A changing electric field creates a magnetic field and a changing magnetic field creates an electric one, so a disturbance travels outward as a wave. Its calculated speed equals the measured speed of light, so light is such a wave, and a spark circuit radiates longer waves that a distant loop can detect.
functions.notes: Unlocks radio. Ties optics to electricity and sets the wavelength limit on how small light can print.

functions.name: Telephone making
functions.mechanism: The voice shakes a thin plate that squeezes carbon grains, changing their resistance, so the current copies the sound wave. At the far end an electromagnet moves an iron plate to recreate it.

functions.name: Power shovel building
functions.mechanism: An engine on a turning platform works a toothed bucket on a boom through ropes and drums.
functions.notes: One machine does the digging of hundreds of labourers.

functions.name: Suspension bridge building
functions.mechanism: The deck hangs from cables in pure tension that pass over towers to massive anchor blocks. Cables are spun in place wire by wire, and the deck is stiffened so wind cannot set it swinging.
functions.notes: Infrastructure. Spans many times longer than any arch or truss.

functions.name: Water turbine making
functions.mechanism: An enclosed wheel of curved blades takes water under pressure all round its rim and releases it with almost no speed left, capturing about nine-tenths of its energy.

functions.name: Alternating current theory
functions.mechanism: Heat lost in a line goes as the square of the current, so power should travel at high voltage and low current. Only current that keeps reversing can be stepped up or down by induction between coils. Coils and capacitors shift its timing, and three staggered phases make a rotating field.
functions.notes: Unlocks transformers, long-distance grids and simple rugged motors.

functions.name: Turbine building
functions.mechanism: Expand high-pressure steam through nozzles onto rings of curved blades on a spinning shaft, in many stages so each takes a small pressure drop. Continuous rotation with no pistons to reverse.

functions.name: Water electrolysis
functions.mechanism: Pass current between two plates in water made conductive with a little acid. Hydrogen bubbles off one plate and half its volume of oxygen off the other, and they are collected separately.

functions.name: Thermionic emission
functions.mechanism: A white-hot filament in a vacuum gives off negative charge that flows to a nearby positive plate but never the other way, a one-way valve. A wire mesh between them, given a small voltage, controls the large current, so a weak signal can be amplified or switched with nothing moving.
functions.notes: Unlocks vacuum tubes and electronics.

functions.name: Crystal detector making
functions.mechanism: A fine wire touching a sensitive spot on a galena crystal passes current one way far more easily than the other, picking the signal off a radio wave. Nobody can yet say why.
functions.notes: The first semiconductor device.

functions.name: Compressor building
functions.mechanism: A motor-driven piston squeezes gas in stages with cooling between, since compression heats a gas and hot gas resists further squeezing.

functions.name: Culture plate pouring
functions.mechanism: Sterile broth set to a jelly in a shallow covered dish. A single microbe landing on it multiplies into a visible colony of identical descendants, which can be picked off as a pure culture.

functions.name: Paper machine building
functions.mechanism: Pulp flows onto an endless moving wire screen, drains, is pressed between felt-covered rolls and dried over steam-heated cylinders into a continuous roll.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Exchange building
functions.mechanism: Every subscriber's line runs to a central office where any two can be joined, by hand at first and then by relays stepping to the dialled digits.
functions.notes: Infrastructure. Instant conversation across a city or continent.

functions.name: Harbour works
functions.mechanism: Breakwaters still the water, the bed is dredged to take deep hulls, and quays carry cranes and rail tracks alongside.
functions.notes: Infrastructure.

functions.name: Lift making
functions.mechanism: A car balanced by a counterweight is hauled by a motor. Spring-loaded jaws grip the guide rails the moment the rope goes slack.

functions.name: Dam building
functions.mechanism: Water pressure grows with depth, so the wall thickens toward its base and resists by weight, or curves upstream to pass the load into the valley sides. A spillway passes floods and the foundation is sealed against seepage.
functions.notes: Infrastructure. Stored water for irrigation, cities, flood control and power.

functions.name: Wind tunnel building
functions.mechanism: A fan draws smooth, even air past a model held on a balance that measures lift and drag. Forces on a small model scale up to the full-size machine.
functions.notes: Hundreds of shapes tested without risking a pilot.

functions.name: Bayer process
functions.mechanism: Hot caustic soda under pressure dissolves the aluminium out of the ore and leaves iron-rich red mud. Cooling and seeding drops out pure aluminium hydroxide, which is roasted to oxide. The liquor is recycled.
functions.notes: The recycled liquor slowly accumulates gallium.

functions.name: Air separation plant building
functions.mechanism: Compress air, cool it, and expand it through a valve so it chills. The cold outgoing gas cools the incoming stream, so each cycle gets colder until the air liquefies. A column then separates it by boiling point.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Nitric acid (ammonia oxidation)
functions.mechanism: Burn ammonia in air over red-hot platinum gauze to nitrogen oxides, and absorb them in water.
functions.notes: Alternative route to Nitric acid without saltpetre.

functions.name: Fertilizer making
functions.mechanism: Neutralise nitric acid with ammonia to a salt that is one-third nitrogen in the form plants take up.
functions.notes: Multiplies Grain yield. Ends dependence on dung and fallow.

functions.name: Refrigeration unit building
functions.mechanism: Compress a vapour, let it shed heat outdoors and liquefy, then let it evaporate at low pressure indoors, where it takes heat in. Work moves heat from cold to hot.

functions.name: Hydrofluoric acid making
functions.mechanism: Sulfuric acid on fluorite releases hydrogen fluoride. It dissolves glass and silica, so it is made and kept in lead or plastic.
functions.notes: The only practical etchant for silicon oxide.

functions.name: Microbiology lab fitting
functions.mechanism: Sterile glassware and media, incubators at body heat, stains that make microbes visible, and a flame to sterilise every tool between uses.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Contact process
functions.mechanism: Burn sulfur and pass the gas with air over a catalyst at about 450 °C, hot enough to be fast and cool enough for the balance to favour the product, then absorb it in strong acid.
functions.notes: Alternative route to Sulfuric acid, at the strength dyes and explosives need.

functions.name: Methanol synthesis
functions.mechanism: Carbon monoxide and hydrogen combine over a catalyst under high pressure. Fewer gas molecules come out than go in, so pressure pushes the balance toward the product.
functions.notes: Alternative route to Methanol.

functions.name: Smokeless powder making
functions.mechanism: Treating cotton with mixed acids builds oxygen into the fibre. Dissolved to a gel and dried into dense grains, it burns layer by layer at a predictable rate, with three times black powder's energy and almost no smoke.

functions.name: Cable laying
functions.mechanism: A copper core insulated in waterproof gum and armoured with steel wire is paid out over a ship's stern. A long cable smears each pulse, so signalling is slow and read with a very sensitive galvanometer.
functions.notes: Infrastructure. Messages between continents in minutes instead of weeks.

functions.name: Rock drill making
functions.mechanism: A piston driven by compressed air hammers a rotating steel bit hundreds of times a minute. The exhaust air helps ventilate the heading.

functions.name: Steel-frame construction
functions.mechanism: A skeleton of steel columns and beams carries every load and the walls become a mere skin. Height is limited by lifts and wind bracing, not by wall thickness.
functions.notes: Many times the people and work per area of city land.

functions.name: Aerodynamics
functions.mechanism: A curved wing at a small angle turns the air downward and is lifted in return, in proportion to air density, area and the square of speed. Lift always brings drag, and past a critical angle the flow breaks away and lift collapses. Steady flight needs the weight ahead of the lift with a tail behind, and control about three axes.
functions.notes: Unlocks aeroplanes, propellers, turbine blading and wind turbines.

functions.name: Transformer building
functions.mechanism: Two coils on a shared core of thin steel plates. Voltage changes in the ratio of their turns and current inversely. Oil carries heat away and insulates.

functions.name: Cracking
functions.mechanism: Heat light oil very briefly to about 850 °C with steam. The chains break into small reactive molecules, mainly ethylene, propylene and benzene, which are cooled at once before they recombine.

functions.name: Engine building
functions.mechanism: Burn the fuel inside the cylinder. Squeezing the air first makes the burn hotter and the expansion larger, and with enough compression injected oil ignites by itself. Four strokes: intake, compression, power, exhaust.
functions.notes: Compact power without a boiler.

functions.name: Cold store building
functions.mechanism: An insulated room held near or below freezing. Cold slows both the chemistry of decay and the growth of the organisms that cause it.
functions.notes: Station. Meat, fruit and medicines survive long transport.

functions.name: Biochemistry
functions.mechanism: Juice pressed from yeast ferments sugar with no living cell present. Life's processes are ordinary chemistry run by enzymes, each a protein that speeds one reaction. The body needs traces of vitamins to make them work, and glands release hormones that regulate distant organs.
functions.notes: Unlocks vitamins, hormones, drug design and industrial fermentation.

functions.name: Selective toxicity
functions.mechanism: Some dyes stain a microbe and leave the tissue round it untouched, so a chemical can bind to something the microbe has and the host lacks. A compound that binds and poisons only the microbe is found by making and testing hundreds of variants of a promising structure.
functions.notes: Unlocks synthetic antimicrobials and systematic drug discovery.

functions.name: Catalytic reforming
functions.mechanism: Over hot platinum, straight-chain molecules rearrange into branched and ring forms that resist igniting too early under compression, so engines can run at higher compression and power.
functions.notes: Fuel for high-performance piston engines.

functions.name: Metallic cartridge making
functions.mechanism: A drawn brass case holds a shock-sensitive primer, the powder and the bullet as one waterproof unit. On firing the case swells to seal the breech, then springs back so it can be pulled out.

functions.name: Gun building
functions.mechanism: A rifled steel barrel built in layers shrunk onto each other, so the inner tube starts out squeezed. A screw breech seals it, and an oil-filled cylinder absorbs the recoil so the gun stays aimed between shots.

functions.name: Tunnelling
functions.mechanism: Drill a pattern of holes, charge, blast, clear the rubble, support the roof, repeat. Survey from both ends keeps the two headings on course to meet within centimetres.
functions.notes: Infrastructure. Rail, road and water through mountains.

functions.name: Power station building
functions.mechanism: Boilers of water-filled steel tubes raise high-pressure steam for a turbine coupled directly to a generator. Spent steam is condensed to pull a vacuum behind the turbine and the water is reused.
functions.notes: Station. Burns Coal continuously. A dam and water turbine are the equivalent on a large river.

functions.name: Arc furnace building
functions.mechanism: Heavy current jumps as an arc between graphite electrodes and the charge. The arc is hotter than any flame and adds no combustion gases, so temperature and chemistry are controlled separately.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Solvent making
functions.mechanism: Add water across propylene's double bond to make isopropanol, and strip hydrogen from that to make acetone. Both dissolve greases and resins and evaporate without residue.

functions.name: Generator set building
functions.mechanism: An oil engine coupled to a generator on one frame, with a governor holding its speed steady.
functions.notes: Electricity independent of the grid. Burns Diesel fuel.

functions.name: Tractor building
functions.mechanism: A low-geared engine on large wheels pulls implements and drives them from a power shaft.
functions.notes: One farmer works many times the land, and the pasture that fed draft animals is freed. Burns Diesel fuel.

functions.name: Vaccine production
functions.mechanism: Grow the microbe in quantity, then kill or weaken it so it can no longer cause disease but still provokes protection. Keep it cold until used.
functions.notes: Childhood killers become rare.

functions.name: Insulin extraction
functions.mechanism: The pancreas hormone is destroyed by the gland's own digestive enzymes when it is minced. Extract it in cold acidified alcohol, which stops those enzymes and dissolves the hormone, then purify by precipitation.
functions.notes: Diabetes stops being fatal. Given by Hypodermic syringe.

functions.name: Synthetic rubber making
functions.mechanism: Polymerise two small molecules from cracked oil as droplets in soapy water, giving a milky liquid like natural latex that is coagulated and cured the same way.
functions.notes: Alternative route to Rubber, independent of tropical plantations.

functions.name: Synthetic fibre spinning
functions.mechanism: Two building blocks, one with an acid group at each end and one with an amine, link alternately into long chains. The melt is forced through fine holes and stretched, which lines the chains up along the fibre.
functions.notes: Nylon, polyester, acrylic: rope, parachutes, tyre cord, clothing.

functions.name: Repeating rifle making
functions.mechanism: A sliding bolt strips a cartridge from a spring-fed magazine, locks it in the chamber and extracts the empty case. Parts are machined to gauge so any bolt fits any rifle.

functions.name: Arc welder making
functions.mechanism: An electric arc between a steel rod and the work melts both. A coating on the rod burns to a gas shield and slag that keep air off the molten pool, giving a joint as strong as the plate.
functions.notes: Replaces rivets in ships, pipelines and frames.

functions.name: Hydroelectric station building
functions.mechanism: Pipes lead water from the top of the dam down to turbines coupled to generators at its foot.
functions.notes: Station. Alternative route to Power station that burns no fuel.

functions.name: Grid building
functions.mechanism: Step the voltage up at the station, carry it on insulated towers, and step it down in stages near the users. Many stations tied together share the load and cover for each other.
functions.notes: Infrastructure. Means of production for anything needing bulk electricity.

functions.name: Chlor-alkali electrolysis
functions.mechanism: Electrolyse brine with the two sides kept apart by a porous wall. Chlorine gas forms at one plate, hydrogen at the other, and caustic soda builds up in the liquid.
functions.notes: Alternative route to Sodium hydroxide.

functions.name: Copper electrorefining
functions.mechanism: Hang impure copper as the positive plate in acid copper solution. Copper dissolves and plates onto the negative sheet at 99.99% purity. Baser metals stay dissolved and precious ones fall as sludge.
functions.notes: Traces of impurity sharply reduce copper's conductivity.

functions.name: Aluminium smelting
functions.mechanism: Alumina melts above 2000 °C, but dissolves in a molten fluoride salt at 950 °C. Current through the bath deposits liquid aluminium at the bottom while the oxygen burns away the carbon anodes.
functions.notes: Carbon alone cannot reduce it. Needs very large amounts of electricity.

functions.name: Tungsten wire making
functions.mechanism: Tungsten melts at 3422 °C, too hot for any crucible. Dissolve it from the ore with alkali, precipitate with acid, reduce the oxide to powder in hydrogen, press it into a bar, fuse the grains by passing current, then hammer and draw it hot.

functions.name: Nickel refining
functions.mechanism: Smelt to a nickel–copper sulfide, roast it to oxide, reduce to crude metal and refine by electrolysis.

functions.name: Ferrochrome smelting
functions.mechanism: Chromium holds its oxygen too tightly for a blast furnace. Arc-furnace heat with carbon reduces the ore to an iron–chromium alloy.

functions.name: Air distilling
functions.mechanism: Liquid nitrogen boils at −196 °C, argon at −186 °C and oxygen at −183 °C, so a tall column separates them. Neon, krypton and xenon are drawn off in traces.
functions.notes: Alternative route to Oxygen.

functions.name: Gallium extraction
functions.mechanism: Gallium follows aluminium through the caustic liquor and builds up as it is recycled. Electrolysis plates it out as a metal that melts in the hand.

functions.name: Calcium carbide making
functions.mechanism: Lime and coke combine only at arc-furnace heat, above 2000 °C, into a grey solid that gives off a flammable gas, acetylene, on contact with water.

functions.name: Magnesium extraction
functions.mechanism: Add lime to strong brine to drop out magnesium hydroxide, convert it with acid to the chloride, dry it and electrolyse it molten.
functions.notes: The lightest structural metal.

functions.name: Stainless steelmaking
functions.mechanism: With more than about 11% chromium, steel grows an invisible chromium oxide skin that reseals itself when scratched. Nickel keeps it tough and workable.
functions.notes: Clean, non-contaminating vessels and pipework.

functions.name: Resistance alloy making
functions.mechanism: A nickel–chromium alloy resists current strongly and forms a tight oxide skin, so it glows red in open air for years without burning through.

functions.name: Capacitor making
functions.mechanism: Roll two long strips of metal foil with oiled paper between them. A large facing area and a thin gap store the most charge.

functions.name: Vacuum tube making
functions.mechanism: Mount a tungsten filament, a wire grid and a nickel plate in a glass bulb, pump it out while baking to drive gas from the metal, and seal. Any remaining gas would be ionised and destroy the filament.
functions.notes: Amplifier and fast switch.

functions.name: Cathode-ray tube making
functions.mechanism: A hot filament at the neck of an evacuated glass funnel fires a narrow beam at a screen coated with zinc sulfide, which glows where struck. Plates or coils steer the beam.
functions.notes: Makes fast electrical signals visible.

functions.name: Ammonia synthesis
functions.mechanism: Nitrogen and hydrogen combine only partly, and the balance favours ammonia at high pressure and low temperature. An iron catalyst makes it fast enough at 450 °C and 200 atmospheres. Ammonia is condensed out and the unreacted gas recycled.
functions.notes: Fixed nitrogen from air.

functions.name: Plastics making
functions.mechanism: Under pressure with a trace of initiator, small double-bonded molecules add to each other into chains thousands of units long. The product softens when heated and can be moulded, extruded or drawn into film.
functions.notes: Polyethylene, PVC and their relatives.

functions.name: Epoxy making
functions.mechanism: Build a short chain with a strained three-atom ring at each end. Mixed with a hardener the rings open and link every chain to its neighbours, setting without shrinkage into a tough adhesive insulator.

functions.name: Insecticide making
functions.mechanism: A chlorinated ring compound that disrupts insect nerves at doses that barely affect mammals, and stays active on a sprayed surface for months.
functions.notes: Suppresses the insects that carry malaria and typhus and that eat crops. It also accumulates up the food chain.

functions.name: Sulfa drug synthesis
functions.mechanism: The drug resembles a nutrient that bacteria must make for themselves but people get from food. Bacteria take it up in place of the real thing and cannot multiply.
functions.notes: First drugs to cure bacterial infections from inside the body.

functions.name: Bleaching powder making
functions.mechanism: Chlorine absorbed in slaked lime gives a dry powder that releases it again in water. It whitens cloth and pulp in hours instead of weeks in the sun, and kills microbes.

functions.name: Steam reforming
functions.mechanism: Methane and steam over hot nickel give hydrogen and carbon monoxide. More steam converts the monoxide to further hydrogen and carbon dioxide, which is scrubbed out.
functions.notes: Alternative route to Hydrogen, the cheapest at scale.

functions.name: Fluoropolymer making
functions.mechanism: A carbon chain completely sheathed in fluorine. The carbon–fluorine bond is the strongest carbon forms, so almost nothing attacks it, nothing sticks to it, and it survives 250 °C.
functions.notes: Seals and linings for the most corrosive processes.

functions.name: Welding torch making
functions.mechanism: Water dripped on carbide makes acetylene, and burning it in pure oxygen gives a flame near 3100 °C, the hottest of any common gas. It melts steel locally to fuse a joint, or cuts by burning a narrow slot.

functions.name: High-speed steel making
functions.mechanism: Tungsten and chromium form very hard particles in the steel that do not dissolve at red heat, so a cutting edge stays hard while glowing. Cutting speeds rise several-fold.

functions.name: Duralumin making
functions.mechanism: Aluminium with about 4% copper, quenched and left for days. The copper gathers into clusters too fine to see that block slip in the crystals, giving the strength of mild steel at a third of the weight.

functions.name: Waterworks building
functions.mechanism: Water seeps slowly through beds of sand whose living surface film traps microbes. A trace of chlorine kills the rest and keeps protecting in the pipes, and mains kept under pressure stop anything leaking in.
functions.notes: Infrastructure.

functions.name: Aero engine building
functions.mechanism: Everything is pared for power per weight: an aluminium body, thin steel cylinders with cooling fins, and many small cylinders instead of a few large ones.

functions.name: Soldering iron making
functions.mechanism: A copper tip stores and conducts heat from an electric element to the joint, hot enough to melt solder but not the parts.

functions.name: Syringe making
functions.mechanism: A hollow needle drawn from steel tube and ground to a slant, on a graduated glass barrel with a close-fitting piston, puts a measured dose into muscle or vein.

functions.name: X-rays
functions.mechanism: Fast electrons striking a metal target give off invisible rays that pass through flesh, wood and paper but are stopped by bone and metal, and that darken a photographic plate. They are waves like light of far shorter wavelength, and long exposure burns.
functions.notes: Unlocks radiography and crystallography.

functions.name: Kraft pulping
functions.mechanism: Hot alkali dissolves the lignin that glues wood fibres together and leaves the cellulose. The spent liquor is burned to recover the chemicals and raise steam.

functions.name: Motor vehicle building
functions.mechanism: The work moves past the workers in sequence, each station doing one operation with interchangeable parts, so a vehicle is completed every few minutes.
functions.notes: Door-to-door transport independent of rail. Burns Gasoline or Diesel fuel.

functions.name: Aeroplane building
functions.mechanism: A spruce frame braced with wire, covered in tightened fabric. The propeller is a rotating wing, twisted along its length because the tip moves faster than the root. The pilot controls pitch, roll and yaw separately.
functions.notes: Burns Gasoline.

functions.name: Oscilloscope building
functions.mechanism: Sweep the beam across the screen at a steady rate while the signal moves it up and down. The trace is a graph of voltage against time.

functions.name: Radio building
functions.mechanism: A coil and capacitor swap energy back and forth at one natural frequency and so select one station. A tube amplifies the weak signal and another keeps the circuit oscillating to transmit.
functions.notes: Communication without wires.

functions.name: Oscillator making
functions.mechanism: Saw a quartz slab at a chosen angle, lap it to thickness, plate electrodes on both faces and connect it in an amplifier's feedback path so the circuit runs only at the crystal's frequency.
functions.notes: The clock that steps a computer.

functions.name: X-ray tube making
functions.mechanism: A hot filament and a heavy copper-backed tungsten target in a hard vacuum, with tens of thousands of volts between them. Nearly all the beam's energy becomes heat, so the target must conduct it away.

functions.name: Blood groups
functions.mechanism: Mix the blood of two people and sometimes the red cells clump. People fall into a few groups according to markers on their cells, and blood is safe to give only between compatible groups.
functions.notes: Unlocks transfusion.

functions.name: Machine papermaking
functions.mechanism: Wood replaces rags as the fibre and a machine replaces the hand mould. Fine clay fills the gaps between fibres to give a smooth printing surface.
functions.notes: Alternative bulk route to Paper: newspapers, packaging, mass literacy.

functions.name: Electronics lab fitting
functions.mechanism: Benches with regulated power, meters, an oscilloscope, magnification and soldering tools.
functions.notes: Station. Means of production for building and testing circuits.

functions.name: X-ray machine building
functions.mechanism: A step-up transformer feeds the tube, the patient stands between tube and plate, and lead screens everything else.
functions.notes: Fractures, bullets and diseased lungs seen without cutting.

functions.name: Blood bank fitting
functions.mechanism: Blood drawn into a salt solution that stops clotting keeps for weeks when chilled, typed and labelled in advance.
functions.notes: Station. Surgery and battle wounds survive heavy blood loss.

functions.name: X-ray crystallography
functions.mechanism: X-ray wavelengths are about the size of the gaps between atoms, so the regular planes of a crystal reflect them only at particular angles. From the pattern of spots on a plate the positions of the atoms can be calculated.
functions.notes: The atomic structure of metals, minerals and, later, proteins and DNA.

functions.name: Switching theory
functions.mechanism: A closed switch is 1 and an open one 0. Switches in series compute AND, in parallel OR, and a relay that opens when energised computes NOT. So any logical expression can be wired, circuits can add binary numbers, and a circuit that feeds its output back to its input remembers.
functions.notes: Unlocks digital logic design.

functions.name: Gyroscope making
functions.mechanism: A fast-spinning balanced wheel in pivoted rings keeps its axis pointing the same way in space while the vehicle turns round it, giving a direction reference that needs no outside signal.

functions.name: Core memory weaving
functions.mechanism: Tiny rings of pressed and fired magnetic oxide are threaded on a grid of wires. Each ring stays magnetised one way or the other, a bit, and flips only when the two wires crossing it both carry current.
functions.notes: Keeps its contents with the power off.

functions.name: Germanium extraction
functions.mechanism: Dissolve the residue in strong acid and distil off germanium chloride, which boils at 83 °C. Add water to get the oxide, and reduce that to metal in hydrogen.

functions.name: Lithium refining
functions.mechanism: Roast the ore so acid can reach the lithium, leach it out as the sulfate, and add soda ash. Lithium carbonate, unusually, is less soluble hot than cold, so it drops out of the heated liquor.

functions.name: Antibiosis
functions.mechanism: A mould that lands on a culture plate leaves a clear ring where bacteria will not grow. Microbes compete by secreting substances that kill others at extreme dilution yet leave animal cells alone, because they attack structures only bacteria have.
functions.notes: Unlocks antibiotics.

functions.name: Quartz fusing
functions.mechanism: Melt selected crystal near 2000 °C and form crucibles, tubes, plates and bell jars. Pure silica glass stays rigid past 1100 °C, barely expands, passes ultraviolet, and adds nothing to silicon but a little oxygen.

functions.name: Photoresist making
functions.mechanism: Dissolve a phenolic resin with a light-sensitive compound that normally stops it dissolving in alkali. Ultraviolet converts that compound to an acid, so exposed areas wash away in developer and unexposed areas stay to resist the etch.

functions.name: Silicon smelting
functions.mechanism: Carbon takes the oxygen from quartz only near 1900 °C, reached in an arc furnace. Wood chips keep the charge open so the gas can escape. The silicon tapped is about 98% pure.

functions.name: Carborundum making
functions.mechanism: Pass heavy current through a carbon core buried in sand and coke. At about 2500 °C they combine into crystals almost as hard as diamond.
functions.notes: Abrasive for sawing and lapping hard crystals.

functions.name: Phosphorus making
functions.mechanism: Heat phosphate with sand and coke. Sand takes the calcium as slag, carbon takes the oxygen, and phosphorus leaves as vapour that is condensed under water because it ignites in air.

functions.name: Ceramic sintering
functions.mechanism: Press very fine pure oxide powder to shape and fire it near 1600 °C. The grains bond by atoms migrating across their contacts without melting, giving a dense, hard, heat-proof insulator.
functions.notes: Spark plugs, circuit substrates, armour, bearings.

functions.name: Copper foil plating
functions.mechanism: Plate copper onto a slowly turning polished drum dipping in the bath, and peel it off continuously as foil of even thickness.

functions.name: Etchant making
functions.mechanism: Dissolve iron in acid and add chlorine to make ferric chloride, which takes copper into solution without giving off gas.

functions.name: Trichlorosilane making
functions.mechanism: Burn hydrogen in chlorine to hydrogen chloride and pass it over powdered silicon at 300 °C. The product is a liquid boiling at 32 °C, so repeated distillation removes the chlorides of boron, phosphorus and metals.
functions.notes: Purifying a liquid is far easier than purifying a solid.

functions.name: Mercury lamp making
functions.mechanism: An arc through mercury vapour in a quartz envelope emits intense light at a few sharp wavelengths in the violet and ultraviolet. Quartz passes ultraviolet where glass absorbs it.
functions.notes: A bright, single-colour ultraviolet source.

functions.name: Silicone making
functions.mechanism: A backbone of alternating silicon and oxygen, as in quartz, carrying organic side groups. It stays flexible from −60 to 250 °C and sheds water.
functions.notes: Sealants, heat-proof rubber, electrical potting.

functions.name: Isocyanate making
functions.mechanism: Put two nitrogen groups on a ring compound from oil, convert them to amines with hydrogen, and turn each amine into a highly reactive isocyanate group using a gas made from carbon monoxide and chlorine. The intermediates are toxic, so the plant is fully enclosed.

functions.name: Polyol making
functions.mechanism: Convert propylene to its oxide, a strained three-atom ring, and open ring after ring onto a starter molecule. Each chain ends in an alcohol group, and chain length decides whether the final product is soft or rigid.

functions.name: Float glass making
functions.mechanism: Molten glass poured onto a bath of molten tin spreads perfectly flat and comes off smooth on both faces, with no grinding. Nitrogen over the bath keeps the tin from oxidising.
functions.notes: Alternative, cheap route to Glass plate.

functions.name: Carbon fibre making
functions.mechanism: Stretch an acrylic fibre, heat it in air so it will not melt, then to over 1500 °C in inert gas. Everything but carbon leaves, in ribbons of graphite-like sheets aligned along the fibre: stiffer than steel at a quarter of the weight.

functions.name: Quantum mechanics
functions.mechanism: Energy is exchanged in indivisible packets. Electrons in an atom can occupy only certain energy levels, which explains spectral lines and the periodic table. Particles behave as waves described by probabilities, and no two electrons can share the same state.
functions.notes: Unlocks solid-state physics and lasers. Required for all later device theory.

functions.name: Circuit board making
functions.mechanism: Press resin-soaked paper and copper foil into a rigid sheet under heat. Print the wiring pattern in acid-proof ink, etch away the bare copper, and drill holes for component leads.
functions.notes: Wiring becomes a printed, repeatable part.

functions.name: Deposition reactor building
functions.mechanism: A sealed bell jar holding thin silicon rods clamped between graphite contacts and heated by passing current through them, with pure gases piped in and waste gas piped out.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Water purifier building
functions.mechanism: Pump water through fine membranes, then through beds of resin beads that swap dissolved ions for hydrogen and hydroxide, which combine to water. Ultraviolet light kills bacteria. Plastic pipework sheds no metal.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Vacuum system building
functions.mechanism: A rotary oil-sealed pump removes most of the air. Then a jet of oil vapour drags the remaining molecules downward and out. Welded stainless walls baked hot give up their adsorbed gas.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Reduction camera building
functions.mechanism: A rigid vibration-free camera photographs a large, accurately drawn master down to a tenth or a hundredth of its size. Drawing errors shrink by the same factor.

functions.name: Fermentation plant building
functions.mechanism: Deep stirred tanks sterilised with steam and fed sterile filtered air from below. One stray microbe ruins a batch, so every valve and seal is steam-sterilisable.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Polyurethane making
functions.mechanism: Isocyanate groups react with alcohol groups within seconds at room temperature, linking everything into a network with nothing left over. A trace of water reacts to give carbon dioxide, which blows the mix into foam.
functions.notes: Cushioning, rigid insulation, elastic fibres, tough coatings.

functions.name: Fracture and fatigue
functions.mechanism: Metal loaded again and again far below its breaking strength grows a crack from any notch or flaw, a little each cycle, until it fails suddenly. Sharp corners multiply the local stress. Structures are designed so a crack is found by inspection before it reaches a dangerous length.
functions.notes: Safe working lives for aircraft, pressure vessels and bridges.

functions.name: Fibreglass moulding
functions.mechanism: Fibres carry the load, and the resin holds them in place and passes load between them. A crack stops at each fibre it meets. The cloth is laid in a mould along the directions of expected stress.

functions.name: Relay computer building
functions.mechanism: Thousands of relays wired as adders and memory, stepped by a motor-driven timing shaft and directed by holes punched in paper tape. It computes a few operations per second.

functions.name: Polysilicon deposition
functions.mechanism: On rods held at 1100 °C the gas reaction runs backwards and deposits silicon atom by atom, growing the rods fat over several days. The cold walls stay clean.
functions.notes: Impurities below one part per billion.

functions.name: Water polishing
functions.mechanism: The result is tested by how poorly it conducts electricity. A single dissolved ion per billion molecules is measurable, and would contaminate a wafer rinsed in it.

functions.name: Evaporator building
functions.mechanism: In high vacuum a metal heated on a tungsten filament boils off, and its atoms fly in straight lines to coat everything facing them with a film of controlled thickness.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Penicillin production
functions.mechanism: Select a high-yielding strain and grow it submerged in an aerated tank on grain liquor and sugar. The mould releases penicillin as its growth slows. Heat and acid destroy it, so the broth is chilled, shifted briefly into solvent and back into water, and dried frozen under vacuum.
functions.notes: Infected wounds, pneumonia and blood poisoning become curable.

functions.name: Carbide tooling making
functions.mechanism: Tungsten carbide powder with a few percent of soft metal is pressed to shape and heated until the metal melts and cements the hard grains. Nearly as hard as diamond, yet tough enough to cut steel.

functions.name: Titanium production
functions.mechanism: Titanium holds oxygen too tightly for carbon and turns brittle if it absorbs any gas. Convert the ore to a liquid chloride and distil it, reduce that with molten magnesium in a sealed argon-filled vessel, and melt the resulting sponge by arc under vacuum.
functions.notes: Strong as steel, 45% lighter, immune to seawater.

functions.name: Information theory
functions.mechanism: Information is measured in bits, the number of yes-or-no answers needed to remove uncertainty. Any message can be turned into bits. Every noisy channel has a capacity, and below it clever coding makes errors as rare as you like.
functions.notes: Unlocks digital communication, error-correcting storage and networking.

functions.name: Stored-program architecture
functions.mechanism: One simple machine following a table of rules can carry out any calculation that can be described at all. Instructions are just numbers, so they are kept in the same memory as the data: a processor fetches each one, decodes it and executes it, and can jump depending on a result.
functions.notes: Unlocks general-purpose computers and software.

functions.name: Metal aircraft building
functions.mechanism: A thin riveted aluminium skin over ribs and stringers carries the loads itself, so no external bracing is needed. Wheels retract, flaps slow the landing and propeller blades change pitch in flight.
functions.notes: Air transport and long-range aviation. Burns High-octane gasoline.

functions.name: Vacuum-tube computer building
functions.mechanism: Tubes switch a million times faster than relays. Thousands of them form the arithmetic and control circuits, a crystal clock keeps them in step, and bits are stored as charge spots on tube screens.
functions.notes: Thousands of operations per second, at the cost of constant tube failures.

functions.name: Band theory of solids
functions.mechanism: In a crystal the sharp levels of single atoms merge into bands. Metals have a partly filled band. Insulators have a full band and a wide gap above it. Semiconductors have a narrow gap, so heat or light frees a few electrons, and both they and the holes they leave carry current.
functions.notes: Unlocks semiconductor devices and predicts which materials will work.

functions.name: Wire bonder building
functions.mechanism: A fine gold wire is pressed onto the chip's metal pad with heat and ultrasonic vibration, which scrubs the surfaces clean so the metals weld without melting.

functions.name: Molecular biology
functions.mechanism: Heredity is carried by a long molecule, DNA: two strands, each a sequence of four bases that pair in one way only, so each strand is a template for the other. The sequence is a code read three bases at a time to specify the units of a protein, and the code is the same in all life.
functions.notes: Unlocks genetic engineering, sequencing and molecular diagnosis.

functions.name: Radar building
functions.mechanism: Send short, intense pulses of centimetre radio waves in a narrow rotating beam. Metal reflects them, and the delay of the echo gives the range and the beam's direction the bearing, drawn on a tube screen.
functions.notes: Ships and aircraft seen at night and through cloud.

functions.name: Superalloy melting
functions.mechanism: Nickel with a little aluminium and titanium forms an ordered second phase that keeps its strength to about 800 °C. Chromium resists oxidation, and melting under vacuum keeps out the gases that would embrittle it.

functions.name: Jet propulsion
functions.mechanism: Propellers lose their grip as the blade tips near the speed of sound. Instead, compress the incoming air, burn fuel in it continuously, and expand the hot gas through a turbine that takes just enough power to drive the compressor. The rest leaves as a fast jet, and thrust is the mass flow times its gain in speed.
functions.notes: Unlocks jet engines and gas turbines.

functions.name: Guidance system building
functions.mechanism: Gyroscopes hold a platform steady and sensors on it measure every acceleration. Adding these up over time gives speed, and again gives position. Circuits steer the engine to hold the planned path and shut it off at the exact speed required.

functions.name: Segregation and zone refining
functions.mechanism: Impurities prefer the liquid to the freezing solid. Sweeping a narrow molten zone slowly along a bar carries them to the far end, and repeated passes reach a few parts per billion. A semiconductor's behaviour is set by impurities at that level, so this purity comes first.
functions.notes: Unlocks ultra-pure crystals.

functions.name: Motor ship building
functions.mechanism: A welded hull, lighter than a riveted one and assembled from prefabricated blocks, driven by an oil engine using half a steamer's fuel. Cargo travels in standard steel boxes lifted straight between ship, train and truck.
functions.notes: The cost of moving goods across oceans collapses.

functions.name: Blade casting
functions.mechanism: Build a ceramic shell round a wax pattern, melt the wax out and pour the alloy in vacuum. Drawing the mould slowly out of the furnace freezes the blade as a single crystal with no grain boundaries to creep apart, and a ceramic core leaves cooling passages.

functions.name: Rocket engine building
functions.mechanism: Turbine-driven pumps force fuel and liquid oxygen into a chamber at high pressure. The fuel first flows through the chamber's walls to cool them. The nozzle narrows to a throat and then flares, turning pressure into exhaust faster than sound.

functions.name: Zone refiner building
functions.mechanism: A water-cooled coil carrying high-frequency current induces heat in a narrow band of the bar without touching it. A motor creeps the coil along the bar, which sits in a graphite boat inside a glass tube.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Jet engine building
functions.mechanism: Rows of compressor blades on one shaft with a turbine, round a ring of burners. The first turbine blades run in gas hotter than their own melting point and survive by air blown through their cooling passages.
functions.notes: Burns Kerosene.

functions.name: Long-range rocket building
functions.mechanism: A thin-skinned shell that is mostly two propellant tanks, steered by heat-proof vanes in the exhaust and by fins. It leaves the atmosphere and coasts on a ballistic arc.
functions.notes: Reaches the edge of space.

functions.name: Germanium zone refining
functions.mechanism: Make many slow passes under inert gas, crop off the dirty end, and freeze the bar from a seed so it forms one continuous crystal.

functions.name: Jet airliner building
functions.mechanism: A pressurised cabin lets it cruise ten kilometres up where thin air means low drag. Swept wings delay the shock waves that form near the speed of sound. The fuselage is a pressure vessel loaded and unloaded every flight, so it is designed against fatigue.
functions.notes: Any two cities within a day of each other.

functions.name: Orbital mechanics
functions.mechanism: A body thrown sideways at about 7.8 km/s falls round the Earth instead of onto it. Speed and height fix the orbit's shape and period: higher is slower, and at 36,000 km one circuit takes exactly a day. Orbits are changed by short burns at chosen points, and returning means shedding all that speed as heat.
functions.notes: Unlocks satellites and navigation constellations.

functions.name: Doping and the p–n junction
functions.mechanism: Adding a few atoms per million from the next column of the table gives spare electrons, n-type. Atoms from the previous column leave holes, p-type. Where the two meet, a barrier forms that conducts one way. A thin third region between two junctions lets a small current control a large one.
functions.notes: Unlocks diodes, transistors, solar cells and LEDs.

functions.name: Single-crystal growth
functions.mechanism: A device needs one unbroken lattice, because boundaries between grains trap charge carriers. Touch a small oriented seed to a melt held just above freezing and withdraw it slowly while turning. Atoms attach in the seed's pattern, and pull speed and temperature set the diameter.
functions.notes: Unlocks ingots and wafers.

functions.name: Germanium transistor making
functions.mechanism: Alloy dots of dopant metal into opposite faces of a thin n-type wafer to form two junctions a hair apart, attach gold leads and seal in a can. It does a tube's job with no heater, no vacuum and a thousandth of the power.

functions.name: Crystal puller building
functions.mechanism: A quartz crucible in a graphite heater inside a sealed chamber, with a seed shaft that rotates and rises at a controlled fraction of a millimetre per second.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Dopant preparation
functions.mechanism: Convert boron and phosphorus into volatile liquids or gases that can be distilled to high purity and metered into a furnace in exact tiny amounts.

functions.name: Diffusion furnace building
functions.mechanism: A quartz tube inside a three-zone electric heater holds wafers at 900–1200 °C to within a degree while measured gases flow past them.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Transistor computer building
functions.mechanism: Transistors replace tubes one for one on plug-in circuit boards. Cool running and long life allow far larger machines that stay up for weeks.

functions.name: Ingot pulling
functions.mechanism: Melt polysilicon with a measured pinch of dopant at 1420 °C under argon, dip the seed, pull a thin neck first so crystal defects grow out to the surface, then widen to full diameter.

functions.name: Contamination control
functions.mechanism: A dust speck is larger than a device feature, and the sodium in one fingerprint ruins a junction. Filter the air until almost no particles remain, keep it flowing one way, cover the people, and use only ultrapure chemicals. The fraction of good devices falls steeply with defects per area.
functions.notes: Unlocks cleanrooms. Sets the yield of every chip function.

functions.name: Filter making
functions.mechanism: Spin molten glass into a mat of fibres finer than a hair and pleat it into a sealed frame. Particles collide with fibres and stick, including ones much smaller than the gaps.

functions.name: Cleanroom building
functions.mechanism: The whole ceiling is filters and the floor is perforated, so air moves straight down and carries particles away. The room is kept above outside pressure, at fixed temperature and humidity, and entered through an airlock in full coveralls.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Wafer slicing
functions.mechanism: Grind the ingot round, saw it into thin discs, lap them flat with abrasive, etch away the saw damage in mixed acids, and polish one face to a mirror with no scratches.

functions.name: Planar process
functions.mechanism: Silicon heated in oxygen grows a tight glassy skin that blocks dopants and protects junctions. Open windows in that skin photographically, diffuse dopants in through the windows only, regrow the skin and repeat. Every device sits in one flat surface, so wiring is a metal film patterned on top and a whole wafer of devices is made at once.
functions.notes: Unlocks silicon transistors and integrated circuits.

functions.name: Solar cell making
functions.mechanism: Light absorbed in silicon frees an electron and a hole. The built-in field of a junction just under the surface sweeps them apart before they can rejoin, driving a current through the outside circuit.

functions.name: Mask making
functions.mechanism: Cut the pattern for one layer at several hundred times full size in a peelable film, photograph it down, then step the tiny image across a glass plate to repeat it for every chip on the wafer.
functions.notes: One mask per layer. All layers must register on each other.

functions.name: Mask aligner building
functions.mechanism: Hold the mask just above the resist-coated wafer, line up marks on both under a split-field microscope with fine screws, clamp, and flash ultraviolet through the mask.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Solar panel assembly
functions.mechanism: Cells are soldered in series to add their voltages and sealed between glass and plastic against weather.
functions.notes: Electricity with no fuel and no moving parts.

functions.name: Silicon transistor making
functions.mechanism: Oxidise, pattern, etch a window, diffuse boron for the base. Repeat with phosphorus for the emitter. Evaporate aluminium and pattern it into contacts. Saw the wafer into chips and bond gold wires. The oxide left in place seals every junction.
functions.notes: Works hotter and more reliably than germanium.

functions.name: Monolithic integration
functions.mechanism: Resistors, capacitors and diodes can be made from the same silicon by the same steps as transistors, kept apart by reverse-biased junctions and joined by the metal layer. A whole circuit is then one piece with no hand-made joints, and its complexity is limited only by defect density and how fine a line can be printed.
functions.notes: Unlocks integrated circuits. Each finer generation of lithography multiplies the components per chip.

functions.name: Integrated circuit making
functions.mechanism: Several rounds of oxidise, pattern and diffuse build transistors and resistors in isolated pockets. One patterned aluminium layer wires them into gates. Each chip is tested on the wafer, sawn out, bonded to a copper frame and moulded in epoxy.
functions.notes: Tens to thousands of components per chip.

functions.name: Magnet making
functions.mechanism: The rare earths are so alike chemically that they are separated by hundreds of repeated transfers between two liquids. Neodymium alloyed with iron and boron, powdered, aligned in a field and fused, makes the strongest permanent magnet known.

functions.name: Process gas making
functions.mechanism: Prepare silane, silicon tetrachloride, fluorine and fluorocarbons, purify each to parts per billion, and deliver them in polished stainless cylinders.

functions.name: Multilayer board making
functions.mechanism: Weave glass fibre into cloth, soak it in epoxy and clad it in copper. Pattern each layer photographically, press a stack of them into one board, drill, and plate copper down the holes to join the layers.

functions.name: Cable making
functions.mechanism: Draw pure copper to fine wire, coat it in plastic and twist it in pairs. Interference picked up equally by both wires of a pair cancels at the receiver.

functions.name: Cooling assembly making
functions.mechanism: A finned block of aluminium on a copper base spreads the chip's heat over a large area, and a fan forces air across the fins.

functions.name: Laser theory
functions.mechanism: An excited atom struck by light of exactly its transition energy emits a second identical wave in step with the first. Keep more atoms excited than not between two facing mirrors and the light builds into an intense beam of one colour, with all waves in step.
functions.notes: Unlocks lasers for measurement, lithography sources and fibre optics.

functions.name: Gas laser making
functions.mechanism: A sealed quartz tube of low-pressure gas excited by an electric discharge, with mirrors at each end aligned parallel to a fraction of a wavelength. One mirror leaks a little of the light as the beam.
functions.notes: Measures distance by counting wavelengths.

functions.name: Programming languages
functions.mechanism: A program can translate notation that people find readable into the machine's own instructions. Layers of such translation, with reusable routines, let one person direct millions of operations without tracking each.
functions.notes: Software functions become possible. Computers can be repurposed without rewiring.

functions.name: Recombinant protein production
functions.mechanism: Cut out a human gene with enzymes that recognise particular sequences and splice it into a small DNA ring that bacteria carry and copy. Grown in a fermenter, the bacteria manufacture the human protein.
functions.notes: Human insulin, growth factors and vaccine proteins without animal sources.

functions.name: Fibre drawing
functions.mechanism: Deposit glass from purified vapours inside a quartz tube, with a little germanium in the centre to raise its bending power. Collapse the tube to a rod and draw it into a hair-thin fibre. Light is trapped in the core by reflection at its boundary and travels for kilometres.

functions.name: Lithium-ion battery making
functions.mechanism: Lithium ions shuttle between a layered metal oxide and graphite, slipping between the sheets of each without rebuilding the structure, so the cell survives thousands of cycles. Lithium reacts with water, so the electrolyte is an organic liquid and assembly is done in dry air.
functions.notes: The most energy per weight of any rechargeable cell.

functions.name: Minicomputer building
functions.mechanism: A complete processor on a few boards of logic chips, small and cheap enough to dedicate to one laboratory or one machine.
functions.notes: Controls later manufacturing equipment.

functions.name: Ion implanter building
functions.mechanism: Strip electrons from dopant atoms, accelerate them through a high voltage, bend the beam with a magnet so only the right mass gets through, and scan it over the wafer. Voltage sets depth and the counted charge sets dose.
functions.notes: Station. Dopant placed by number, cold, instead of by soaking in heat.

functions.name: Plasma etcher building
functions.mechanism: A radio-frequency field tears a thin gas into reactive fragments and charged particles that are driven straight down onto the wafer. They etch vertically, where a liquid etch also eats sideways under the mask.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Deposition tool building
functions.mechanism: Flow reactive gases over heated wafers at low pressure. They decompose on the hot surface and leave an even film of silicon, oxide or nitride. Slower still, the film continues the wafer's own crystal.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Disk drive building
functions.mechanism: A polished aluminium disc with a magnetic coating spins under a tiny electromagnet that flies on a film of air a fraction of a micron above it. The head magnetises spots to write and senses them to read, and a coil-and-magnet arm moves it between tracks.
functions.notes: Bulk storage that keeps its contents without power.

functions.name: Planarizer building
functions.mechanism: Press the wafer face-down on a spinning pad fed with a slurry that softens the surface chemically while fine abrasive wipes it off. High spots go fastest, so each layer ends flat enough for the next to be focused.
functions.notes: Station. Makes ten or more wiring layers possible.

functions.name: Power supply building
functions.mechanism: Rectify the mains, chop it at high frequency with transistor switches through a small transformer, and smooth the output. A control chip varies the switching to hold the low voltages steady.

functions.name: Motherboard assembly
functions.mechanism: Place the support chips, sockets and connectors on the board with solder paste and pass it through an oven that melts every joint at once. Gold-plated contacts stay free of oxide.

functions.name: Wind turbine building
functions.mechanism: Three long blades shaped as twisted wings turn slowly on a tall tower. Power rises with the cube of wind speed and the square of blade length. Controls turn the blades and the head to suit the wind.
functions.notes: Electricity with no fuel.

functions.name: Launch vehicle building
functions.mechanism: Two or three stages, each with its own engines and tanks, dropped when empty. The tanks are the structure, thin enough to need internal pressure to stand, and foam-insulated where they hold liquefied gas. Engines swivel to steer along a computed path.

functions.name: Atomic clock making
functions.mechanism: Lock a quartz oscillator to the frequency of one particular transition in an atom, which is identical in every such atom everywhere. It drifts by a second in millions of years.

functions.name: Operating systems
functions.mechanism: A supervising program shares one machine among many jobs and users. It hands out processor time in slices, keeps each program's memory separate, presents every device as a file, and recovers when one job fails.
functions.notes: Unlocks multi-user machines. Required for a Server.

functions.name: Electronic design automation
functions.mechanism: A chip of many thousands of transistors cannot be drawn or checked by hand. Describe its logic in a language, simulate it before building, let programs generate, place and wire the gates, and verify the layout against the manufacturing rules.
functions.notes: Unlocks large-scale chips. Each generation of chips is designed on the last.

functions.name: Stepper building
functions.mechanism: Project the mask through a lens that shrinks it five times, expose one chip, move and repeat. The smallest line printable is about the wavelength divided by the lens's light-gathering angle. A laser counting wavelengths positions the stage to a few hundredths of a line width.
functions.notes: Station. The mask never touches the wafer, so defects stop accumulating.

functions.name: Laser diode making
functions.mechanism: In gallium arsenide, electrons and holes that meet at a junction give up their energy as light. Sandwich a thin layer between layers of wider gap to trap both carriers and light, and cleave the crystal so its own end faces are the mirrors.
functions.notes: A laser the size of a grain of salt, switched billions of times a second.

functions.name: CT scanner building
functions.mechanism: Rotate the tube and a ring of detectors round the patient, taking hundreds of views. A computer solves for the density at every point of the slice.
functions.notes: Cross-sections of the living body.

functions.name: CNC machine building
functions.mechanism: Motors drive each axis through precise screws, with sensors reporting position back. A program of coordinates makes the cutter follow any three-dimensional contour to microns, identically every time.
functions.notes: Station. Complex parts without templates or hand skill.

functions.name: Satellite building
functions.mechanism: It must run unattended for years in vacuum, hard sunlight, deep cold and radiation, with no repair, so parts are duplicated and the whole is tested in a vacuum chamber first. Panels supply power and a battery covers the time in Earth's shadow.
functions.notes: Global relay of signals, weather watching and observation from orbit.

functions.name: Network protocols
functions.mechanism: Cut each message into small addressed packets that find their own way through a mesh of links and are reassembled on arrival. Checksums, acknowledgements and resending make a reliable service from unreliable links, and agreed layers let any two machines talk.
functions.notes: Unlocks internetworking. Required for a Server.

functions.name: Reticle writing
functions.mechanism: Coat a quartz plate with a thin chromium film and resist. A computer steers a focused beam to draw the pattern straight from design data, and the chromium is etched. Hard chrome on quartz survives cleaning and passes ultraviolet.
functions.notes: One per layer, at five times chip size.

functions.name: Wafer fab building
functions.mechanism: Every tool for a complete process sits in one cleanroom with piped ultrapure water, gases and chemicals. Wafers go round the loop of deposit, pattern, etch and implant a dozen or more times.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Optical link building
functions.mechanism: A laser diode flashes bits into the fibre, a light-sensitive junction at the far end turns them back to current, and repeaters regenerate the signal at intervals.
functions.notes: Long-distance data at rates no copper cable carries.

functions.name: Composite layup
functions.mechanism: Stack sheets of aligned fibre pre-soaked in resin in chosen directions on a mould, seal under a vacuum bag, and cure under heat and pressure to squeeze out every void.
functions.notes: Airframes and rocket structures lighter than aluminium.

functions.name: Microprocessor fabrication
functions.mechanism: Build field-effect transistors: a thin grown oxide under a silicon gate, with implanted regions either side that align themselves to the gate edge. Tens of thousands to millions of them, wired in metal, form a whole processor on one chip.

functions.name: Memory chip fabrication
functions.mechanism: Each bit is a tiny capacitor behind one transistor, repeated in a vast regular grid. The charge leaks away in milliseconds, so the chip reads and rewrites every cell continuously.
functions.notes: Replaces Core memory.

functions.name: Network card building
functions.mechanism: Circuits that frame outgoing data into packets with an address and checksum, drive them onto the cable, and recognise and check the packets addressed to this machine.

functions.name: Crewed spacecraft building
functions.mechanism: A sealed cabin with a breathable atmosphere and a means of removing exhaled carbon dioxide. A blunt shield of resin chars and erodes on the way down, carrying the heat away with it, and parachutes finish the descent.
functions.notes: Capstone.

functions.name: Workstation building
functions.mechanism: A full computer on one board with a graphics screen, on every engineer's desk.
functions.notes: Means of production for chip design and for controlling later equipment.

functions.name: Scanner building
functions.mechanism: A pulsed laser of rare gas and fluorine gives deep-ultraviolet light at 248 or 193 nm, less than half the mercury wavelength. Lenses must be fused quartz or fluorite crystal, since glass is opaque there. Mask and wafer are scanned in step past a slit, and water between lens and wafer sharpens the image further.
functions.notes: Station. Features far smaller than the light's own wavelength.

functions.name: DNA sequencer building
functions.mechanism: Copy the DNA with each of the four bases carrying a dye of a different colour, sort the fragments by length in fine tubes, and read the colour order with a laser.

functions.name: Navigation constellation
functions.mechanism: Each satellite broadcasts its position and the exact time. A receiver compares the arrival times from four of them and solves for its own position and clock error. Light covers 30 cm in a billionth of a second, so the clocks must agree to that order.
functions.notes: Infrastructure. Position to within metres anywhere on Earth.

functions.name: Advanced fab building
functions.mechanism: A fab where wafers travel in sealed carriers between hundreds of tools under computer scheduling, every step is measured, and air and chemicals are cleaner by orders of magnitude.
functions.notes: Station.

functions.name: Server processor fabrication
functions.mechanism: Billions of transistors with gates a few tens of nanometres long, where electrons begin to leak straight through barriers. Tungsten plugs contact the silicon. Copper wiring is plated into etched trenches and polished flat, layer on layer. The chip is flipped onto a small circuit board on solder bumps.

functions.name: Memory module fabrication
functions.mechanism: The storage capacitors are etched as deep narrow holes or tall stacks to keep enough charge in a shrinking footprint. Chips are mounted in rows on a small board with spare bits that detect and correct errors.

functions.name: Server
functions.mechanism: Assemble processors, memory, drives, power and network into a rack chassis and install an operating system that lets many remote users share the machine over the network, around the clock.

functions.name: Data center building
functions.mechanism: Rows of racked servers fed by duplicate power paths, with batteries to bridge the seconds until the generators start, chillers to remove the heat, and fibre links to the wider network.
functions.notes: Infrastructure. Capstone.
